Title: Analytics Engineer _Decision Logic / Rules (w/m/d)
Description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

metrify is Enpal’s smart metering unit and the digital infrastructure for a smart energy ecosystem. With tens of thousands of iMSys units installed and scalable processes, we make energy measurable, controllable, and economically viable—and, together with our partners, we are laying the groundwork for new business models for the energy transition.

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer (Decision Logic / Rules) to join Metrify Smart Metering and take end-to-end ownership to develop mission-critical services, data workflows, and third-party integrations. This is not a front-end focused ( BI dashboard/reporting) ; instead, you will transform complex operational rules into clear, maintainable decision logic; and build and optimize them in our data platform. You’ll work closely with our Product and Operations teams to ensure our automation is not only correct, but scalable and auditable, forming the backbone of our smart metering platform. You will drive both what needs to be built and how to build it, turning shared ideas into working solutions, with full ownership from idea to deployment.

What You’ll Do


Design and maintain robust data models: You’ll build and validate data models that support regulatory market communication, device operations, and forecasting use cases.
Ensure data quality and process reliability: You’ll analyze data quality, detect anomalies, and propose improvements across our metering and backend processes.
Translate and operationalize complex rules: You’ll convert regulatory and operational requirements into precise, maintainable, and auditable decision logic within our data platform.
Structure and validate business requirements: You’ll transform ambiguous needs into clear, testable rule definitions (e.g., decision tables, condition trees, pseudocode) with strong traceability.
Implement and optimize rule-driven logic: You’ll develop, test, and refine logic using SQL and Python within our current tech stack (Snowflake, Azure), ensuring performance and scalability.
Collaborate and document: You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams, while maintaining clear documentation of rule behavior, dependencies, and change history.


What you’ll bring


You have at least 4 years of hands-on experience in Data Analysis or Analytics Engineering, ideally in an infrastructure-heavy or regulated environment.
You bring hands-on experience with dbt,SQL, Python and large, complex datasets, including raw time series data. You know how to clean and transform data into actionable insights. You also bring experience translating operational rules into decision logic.
Familiarity with Azure, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, or data modeling concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, staging layers) is a nice-to-have, as is experience with energy market data flows or smart metering.
You communicate clearly in English. Knowledge of German is a strong plus.
You enjoy working in agile, cross-functional teams and take ownership beyond writing queries, contributing to the design and improvement of data systems as a whole.


What we offer


Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.
The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.
The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.
Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.
Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.
Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.
The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.
Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.


At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - CRM (m/f/d)
Description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

As a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d), you will join our global CRM team. This is an important role for CRM at Flix as we expand our capabilities, redefine our communication strategy and constantly optimize for maximum growth, as well as scalability and efficiency. We support global market growth with our marketing activities to increase repeated purchases and prevent churn. We always aim for cutting-edge technologies and a high level of innovation. By joining our team, you will be a crucial part of driving the team forward, developing our brands and customer communication throughout the globe.

About The Role


Own CRM analytics and reporting across 45+ markets, delivering clear visibility into performance, customer behavior, and commercial impact
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards providing real-time tracking of CRM performance, targets, and business trends
Deliver actionable insights on campaign performance, drivers of customer behavior, value-generating segments, and cross-market differences
Develop scalable, automated reporting solutions alongside deep-dive analyses and ad hoc business investigations
Monitor and optimize key CRM KPIs (engagement, conversion, retention, reactivation, communication effectiveness) and customer lifecycle performance
Partner with CRM, data, and product teams to improve segmentation, personalization, experimentation, tracking quality, and data reliability
Evaluate A/B tests and proactively identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities, presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders


About You


5+ years of experience in data analytics or BI, ideally within CRM, marketing, or e-commerce environments
Proven track record of building dashboards and automated reporting solutions for non-technical stakeholders
Strong SQL expertise (CTEs, window functions, multi-table joins) in a modern cloud data warehouse, preferably Snowflake
Advanced Power BI skills including data modeling, DAX, and best-practice dashboard design and visualization
Solid understanding of marketing and CRM KPIs (conversion, engagement, attribution, customer lifetime value)
Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, and marketing/CRM teams; familiarity with marketing automation tools (e.g., Braze is a plus)
Strong data storytelling, statistical literacy (e.g., significance testing), and a structured, detail-oriented, and autonomous working style
Proficiency in English


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Title: Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x) in the field of AI & Satellite Data
Description:
Build the Market Leader in Satellite Analytics with us at LiveEO

LiveEO uses satellite data and AI to monitor critical infrastructure at scale. As a Geospatial Data Analyst (f/m/x), you’ll sit at the heart of our operations, working with geospatial and satellite data to make sure our analytics projects are delivered reliably, accurately, and on time.

You’ll work closely with Project Managers, our Operations Support Studio, engineers, and product teams - investigating data, understanding our analytics pipelines, solving delivery issues, and helping us continuously improve how our technology performs in real-world use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure.

This role is a maternity leave cover and is offered on a fixed-term contract for 1 year.

Your challenge


Analyze, validate, and interpret geospatial and satellite data across global customer projects
Take ownership of analytics deliveries and help ensure high technical quality and reliability
Understand and adapt to different analytics use cases across energy and transportation infrastructure
Investigate data and pipeline issues, identify root causes, and communicate findings clearly to engineering teams
Work closely with engineers, Project Managers, and the Operations Support Studio to resolve issues and keep deliveries moving
Develop a strong end-to-end understanding of our analytics pipelines and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams when you identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement
Use AI coding and analysis tools such as Claude or Cursor for data validation, pipeline debugging, and analysis - while critically validating their output before acting on it
Work with tools and technologies including QGIS, Python, SQL, AWS, remote sensing tools, and large-scale geospatial datasets


Your profile


A degree in geoinformatics, remote sensing, geography, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or another quantitative/technical field
Hands-on experience working with geospatial data and GIS tools, ideally QGIS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex data or technical issues in a structured way
A high level of ownership and self-management - you ask questions, seek clarity, and proactively move problems toward resolution
Comfortable using AI coding and analysis tools as part of your daily work, while applying your own judgement to verify results
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and customer requirements can change
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
A collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
You live in Berlin or are willing to relocate


Nice to have:


Experience with Python and SQL
Remote sensing / Earth Observation experience
Experience with geodatabases and large-scale data management
AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience
Machine learning or deep learning knowledge
Software engineering experience
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Prefect


Your Benefits


The opportunity to work with satellite and geospatial data on real-world infrastructure challenges across the globe and contribute directly to how LiveEO delivers its analytics products.
We empower employees to drive their own career development, take initiative and have the freedom to be creative and bold.
Not an overtime culture - we take care that overtime is done only as a necessity and always offset with time off and rest.
A collaborative and learning environment - frequent internal workshops, knowledge sharing sessions, journal clubs and hackathons, with the opportunity to learn across geospatial analytics, AI and satellite technology.
Office located in the centre of Berlin Kreuzberg with free fruit, nuts and drinks.
Potential to participate in the employee stock option program.
Urban Sports membership and BVG subsidy, Jobrad, corporate pension program.
A diverse and vibrant international environment of 30+ different nationalities.


About Us

LiveEO is a well funded startup founded in 2018 and based in Berlin. Our primary service is modelling risk to our customers’ assets and infrastructure from vegetation, ground deformation and change detection. We currently have around 160 employees from all over the world with a variety of backgrounds

Title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
Description:
Who We Are

Sandbox Interactive is the ambitious game development studio behind the award-winning game Albion Online. The game is the first true cross-platform MMO, and is playable on Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android with more than 350.000 daily players and over 2 million monthly visitors on our website. We started as a small independent group of experienced gaming professionals in 2012, and now employ an international team of more than 100 people. Since 2020, Sandbox Interactive has been part of the Stillfront Group. Our team is passionate about making Albion Online the best game it can be, and we’re constantly on the lookout for talented individuals to join our growing team in the heart of Berlin.

Your Game

As a Data Engineer, you'll build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers game analytics, live operations, reporting, and business intelligence across Sandbox Interactive. Combining software engineering with data analytics, you'll enable teams to make data-driven decisions by delivering reliable pipelines, scalable data models, and meaningful visualizations.

Your Responsibilities:


Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure
Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations that enable data-driven decision making
Build and optimize data models, ETL processes, and SQL queries
Integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring data quality and reliability
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
Monitor and improve our data platform, logging infrastructure, and reporting systems
Support analytics initiatives by providing reliable, accessible, and actionable data


Your Talent

Minimum Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience designing and optimizing complex queries
Professional experience with Python, C#, or another modern programming language
Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and ETL workflows
Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases
Experience working with BI and data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Google Data Studio, or similar)
Knowledge of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and software engineering best practices
Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal and written) in English


Preferred Qualifications:


Experience in the games industry or another data-driven digital product environment
Experience with Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana (ELK Stack) or similar observability tools
Experience with Apache Cassandra or other distributed databases
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering ecosystems
Experience building reporting solutions for live operations or product analytics


Our Offer


BVG corporate ticket:
Receive a free company ticket for Germany's public transportation system
Personal Development:
Have a high degree of autonomy and ownership from the start
Develop your skills through company-sponsored training and language courses
Enjoy company-sponsored tickets for Gamescom Dev & other game conferences
Hybrid Work model:
Combine the best of both worlds, and enjoy the freedom to switch between working in the office and working remotely
Health & Wellbeing:
Discounted membership to Urban Sport Club for fitness and wellness
Access to nilo health for confidential mental health support, coaching, and wellbeing resources
Extra vacation days awarded based on years of service, up to a maximum of 30 days annually
Modern & Well-Equipped Office:
Work in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg, a central, vibrant neighborhood in Berlin with many dining and entertainment options
Enjoy height-adjustable tables, ergonomic chair options, dimmable lighting, and acoustic panels
Start-up perks:
Benefit from free drinks and snacks in the office
Participate in team events, breakfast weeks, summer and winter parties
Sustainable business:
Be part of a successful, profitable company on a continued growth path
Gaming-driven culture:
Work alongside a supportive team of gaming enthusiasts who are deeply committed to their craft
Global reach:
Join a team of industry experts shaping a game enjoyed by hundreds of thousands worldwide

Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Consultant AI & Data Analytics (m/w/d).

Als Consultant AI & Data Analytics (m/w/d) berätst du Mandanten im Risikomanagement nachhaltig. In diesem Rahmen erarbeitest und setzt du innovative, cutting-edge Lösungen um.

Artificial Intelligence: Dein Fokus liegt auf diversen Leistungskernen und ihrem Einsatz: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Trustworthy AI

Technologie: Alles dreht sich um Big-Data und Cloud Technologien - vor allem Amazon Webservices (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure

Abschluss in Informatik, Statistik, Finanz-/Wirtschaftsmathematik, Ingenieurwesen oder Naturwissenschaften, Know-how in Programmiersprachen und Analysewerkzeugen
Sicherer Umgang mit Python und Frameworks (sklearn, TensorFlow, Keras, Pytorch) oder R (bzw. Java, C++), Daten-Mgt (SQL, Spark, Hadoop) und Analyse-Tools (u.a. Qlik, Tableau)
Freude an komplexen Aufgaben und wie sie ebenso kreativ wie konzeptionell zu lösen sind - vor allem mit Daten und statistischer Modellierung
Winning Attitude, die sich im Tagesgeschäft in unternehmerischem Handeln, Wissbegierde und Kreativität sowie einer kunden- und teamorientierten Haltung zeigt
Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift


Deine Chance:


Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits

Vielfältige Gestaltungsräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur - u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke

  • Freude an komplexen Aufgaben und wie sie ebenso kreativ wie konzeptionell zu lösen sind - vor allem mit Daten und statistischer Modellierung
  • Winning Attitude, die sich im Tagesgeschäft in unternehmerischem Handeln, Wissbegierde und Kreativität sowie einer kunden- und teamorientierten Haltung zeigt
  • Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift

Deine Chance:

  • Spannende Aufgaben in einem innovativen Umfeld mit hochmotivierten Kolleg:innen, die sich schon jetzt auf deine Impulse freuen
  • Gute Rahmenbedingungen mit attraktivem Gehalt und zahlreichen Zusatzleistungen, z. B. Firmen-Smartphone zur privaten Nutzung, Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits
  • Work-Life-Balance durch Remote-Working & Teilzeit, Sabbaticals, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events, Well-being Angebote wie z. B. Gesundheitstage, Kooperationen mit Fitness-Anbietern und den Familienservice, der dich bei privaten Herausforderungen unterstützt

Job Title

EIC Research Analyst

Job Description Summary

The Research Analyst is responsible for research, data & analytics and reporting activities across the German market. This role is designed to support the organic growth of the German businesses by thought leadership and insight outputs to help generate leads and opportunities in the business.

The role will directly report to and work closely with the Research Team Lead, Germany to ensure consistency of client experience, processes and operational excellence across the EMEA region. The role will also cooperate with colleagues from local business services departments, as well as other central functions, mainly Marketing and Data & Analytics teams.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:


Ensure real estate data collection and update of existing databases (office, industrial, retail, residential, hotel, investment etc.) to deliver regular market and economic updates, with specific focus areas determined by team structure, location, and other relevant factors.
Cooperate with other business services teams to gather, analyse, and utilize local and regional market insights, including competitive, client, and industry data, to produce market thought leadership.
Support business development activities, including presenting market updates to clients.
Undertake independent market analyses for ad-hoc reports for clients as defined by the business.
Support marketing and communication activities in line with the company content strategy defined by the Head of Business Development Services, Germany.
Contribute to C&W brand visibility through active participation in public events and social media.
Cooperate with C&W research teams in other countries and the wider EMEA team.


Knowledge & Experience


Strong analytical skills with expertise in data collection, statistical analysis, and market research
Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and assess market dynamics with accuracy
Excellent communication skills for translating complex data into clear reports, presentations, and visualizations
Creative problem-solving and effective collaboration in dynamic, deadline-driven environments
Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, OneDrive, SharePoint); familiarity with Power BI, Power Query, and GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS)
Experience in professional services or real estate sector, aligned with role seniority
Degree in Economics, Geography, Real Estate, or related field preferred


What We Offer

Early assumption of responsibility, flat hierarchies and an international and modern working environment, attractive and performance-related remuneration, flexible working hours with the possibility of hybrid work scheme, 30 vacation days plus special leave days, further training and development opportunities, company pension scheme.

Title: Consultant Digital Analytics (all genders)
Description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE


Analytics-Konzeption: Entwickle Analytics-Strategien und konzipiere individuelle Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen in Web- und App-Projekten.
Implementierung: Implementiere Analytics-Tools und richte Tag-Management-, Tracking- und Consent-Management-Systeme für unsere Kunden ein.
Reporting & Dashboards: Erstelle Berichte und interaktive Dashboards, visualisiere Ergebnisse und interpretiere diese gemeinsam mit internen Teams im Online Marketing.
Compliance & Prozesse: Optimiere Prozesse und unterstütze unsere Kunden dabei, technische und rechtliche Anforderungen wie die Cookie-Compliance einzuhalten.
Wissensvermittlung: Vermittle Wissen, indem du interne und externe Schulungen zu Analytics-Themen durchführst.
Strategische Beratung: Berate Kunden und begleite sie beim strategischen Ausbau ihres Trackings.


DEIN PROFIL


Analytics- und Tracking-Systeme: Durch deine mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 3 Jahre) kennst du bereits Tools wie Piwik PRO, Matomo oder Google Analytics und bist mit Tag-Management- und Dashboard-Systemen vertraut. Aber auch Consent Management Plattformen sind dir nicht unbekannt und du verstehst die Funktion von Cookie Bannern auf Webseiten und in Mobile Apps.
Online-Marketing Expertise: Insbesondere datengetriebene Kampagnen gehören zu deinem Fachwissen.
Technisches Verständnis: Du bringst fundiertes Know-how in Webtechnologien und Programmiersprachen wie HTML, CSS und JavaScript mit.
Kenntnisse zur strategischen Analytics-Beratung: Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen Datenstrategien für Unternehmen mit und bist begeisterungsfähig für technologische Entwicklungen und Trends im Analytics-Bereich.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist vertriebsorientiert und begeisterst andere für das Thema Digital Marketing.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.


Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Title: Demand Planning Expert
Description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are currently looking for a Demand Planning Expert who will be integral to driving high-level performance across Lovehoney Group. Partnering directly with Commercial, Category Management, Finance and Supply Planning teams, your focus will be on delivering accurate, data-driven demand forecasts that support product availability, optimise inventory investment and enable commercial growth. In this role, you will combine your analytical expertise with your commercial insight to continuously improve forecast accuracy and planning performance. You will develop skills crucial to advancing in a competitive, fast-paced retail sector, all within a company that prizes dedication and results.

What You Will Do


Develop and maintain accurate demand forecasts across categories, channels and markets, combining statistical forecasting with commercial insight and incorporating promotions, product launches and market trends.
Partner with Commercial, Category Management, Marketing, Finance and Supply Planning teams to create a robust consensus demand plan, challenging assumptions and ensuring timely, high-quality inputs.
Analyse forecast performance and planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy, forecast bias and service levels, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to improve planning performance.
Support the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process by preparing demand planning outputs, presenting insights and providing recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Act as the subject matter expert for demand planning systems, forecasting methodologies and data, driving continuous improvement through automation, advanced analytics and AI-enabled forecasting techniques.



What You Should Bring


Significant experience in Demand Planning or Forecasting, ideally within retail, ecommerce or FMCG.
Strong understanding of forecasting methodologies, demand planning principles and S&OP / Integrated Business Planning processes.
Experience using demand planning and forecasting systems, with advanced Excel skills and the ability to analyse and interpret large datasets; Power BI experience is desirable.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
A continuous improvement mindset, with experience enhancing planning processes, systems and data quality; exposure to automation, AI or advanced analytics is desirable.



What We Can Offer You


A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events
Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun
Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration
Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.



Our interview process


CV review
Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Team Members
Hiring Manager Interview
Hiring Team Interview
Leadership Interview



Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

We currently have a hybrid work model supporting a blend of in-office and remote work (3 days per week in-office)

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: Careers | Lovehoney Group

Title: Data Engineer CPO (m/w/d)
Description:
Deine Aufgaben


Du entwickelst unsere Datenstrukturen und Datenbanken weiter und schaffst damit die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im CPO.
Du definierst gemeinsam mit Operations und Management relevante KPIs und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.
Du analysierst Daten, erkennst Muster und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
Du entwickelst pragmatische Reports und Dashboards, die im operativen Alltag wirklich genutzt werden.
Du integrierst unterschiedliche Systeme und Datenquellen und sorgst für verlässliche Datenflüsse.
Du baust automatisierte Schnittstellen und Prozesse auf.
Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität und konsistente Stammdaten sicher.
Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Product, Tech und Management zusammen und bringst deine Perspektive aktiv ein.


Dein Profil


Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung
1-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung oder Praktika im Bereich Startups, Energie, Tech-Consulting, Business Development oder Technologie
Du bringst Kenntnisse in SQL mit; Erfahrung mit modernen Datenbankplattformen wie Supabase und Neon Database sowie mit NoSQL, z. B. Firebase oder Azure Table Storage, ist ein Plus.
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für APIs, Systemintegrationen und Automatisierungen
Du hast Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen, Datenmodellierung und Datenbanken
Unternehmerisch geprägte, proaktive Arbeitsweise mit klarer Owner-Mentalität
Du hast Freude daran, technische und operative Fragestellungen miteinander zu verbinden
Starkes Interesse an der Energiewende und an integrierten Lösungen aus PV, Ladeinfrastruktur, Stromliefermodellen (z. B. PPA/IPP) und Batteriespeichern
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

CUBOS verfolgt die ambitionierte Vision, Europas führender Anbieter für betriebliches Energiemanagement-as-a-Service zu werden. Als innovatives Technologieunternehmen entwickeln und implementieren wir eigene Hardware- und Softwarelösungen, die den Weg in eine nachhaltige Zukunft ebnen. Title: Senior Product Analyst, Geo Platform
Description:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?


Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.


About The Role

At Bolt, Product Analysts are embedded directly into product teams, partnering with Product, Engineering and Data Science to identify opportunities, shape decisions and measure impact.

In the Platform Product group, we support products and capabilities that are built once centrally and used across Bolt. Within the Platform group, Geo domain builds the location intelligence behind how people and goods move — including routing, ETAs, search, maps, live traffic and navigation. One of Geo’s biggest bets is Bolt Navigation, our in-house turn-by-turn navigation experience built directly into the Bolt Driver app. We’re creating navigation around the specific needs of drivers today, with the potential to serve couriers and other Bolt use cases in the future.

As a Senior Product Analyst in the Geo domain, you’ll work on some of our most complex product analytics problems. What makes a route good? Why do drivers follow or deviate from a suggested route? Which real-world signals from drivers can improve our maps? And how do small improvements to a journey translate into marketplace impact at Bolt’s scale? You’ll be a thought partner to Product Managers, Engineers and Data Scientists — helping the team understand users, define success, discover opportunities, design experiments and decide what to build next.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Define what great navigation looks like: develop metrics and measurement frameworks across navigation quality, adoption, route quality, ETA accuracy, traffic, driver behaviour and the end-to-end journey.
Turn complex geospatial data into product insights: work with large-scale GPS, routing, search, map and behavioural data to understand what happens in the real world and where our products can improve.
Lead product discovery and deep dives: turn ambiguous questions into structured analyses, uncover root causes, size opportunities and translate findings into clear product recommendations.
Design and evaluate experiments: partner with product teams on experiment design and analysis, and use appropriate statistical or causal methods when conventional A/B testing is not enough.
Build learning loops around our products: connect product behaviour, driver feedback, experiments and marketplace outcomes to help Geo continuously improve routing, navigation and map quality.
Own measurement from discovery to launch and beyond: define success criteria before launches, ensure the right instrumentation is in place, evaluate results and identify the next iteration.


About You


You have strong experience in Product Analytics, Data Science or a similarly analytical product role, ideally within a technology or product company.
You have excellent product thinking and are comfortable taking an ambiguous product problem, structuring it and determining what evidence is needed to make a decision.
You can rank your SQL skills as “outstanding” and Python/R experience as “profound”.
You can prove your ability to lead experimentation: applied statistics, designing and analysing experiments, providing recommendations.
You have strong business and product judgement. You can move from detailed analysis to the bigger question of what should we do differently as a result?
Your verbal and written communication skills are outstanding and you are fluent in English.


Why you’ll love it here


Accelerate your professional growth with unique career opportunities.
Enjoy a rewarding salary and stock options, knowing that as Bolt succeeds, so do you.
Take care of your physical and mental health with our wellness perks.
Celebrate 5 years at Bolt with a 1-month paid sabbatical to recharge.
Connect with colleagues at annual company events and smaller team gatherings.
Balance flexibility and in-person collaboration with our hybrid model, including at least 12 monthly in-office days.


Some perks may differ depending on your location and role.

At Bolt, using AI daily is a baseline expectation for everyone. If there’s a faster, smarter way to do your work, we expect you to find it. You’re still responsible for the output, so the standard stays high when using AI tools.

Experience is great, but what we really look for is drive, intelligence, and integrity. So even if you don’t tick every box, please consider applying!

Everyone is welcome

Bolt is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, colour, nationality, religion, gender or gender identity, sexual orientation, age, or disability.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are happy to make reasonable accommodations throughout our hiring process. If you require any adjustments, please let us know.

Title: Junior Global Pricing Manager (m/f/d)
Description:
Ready to shape the pricing legacy of one of the world’s most prestigious luxury watchmakers? Join our team in Berlin as Junior Global Pricing Manager (m/f/d) in full-time.

About The Position

At A. Lange & Söhne, we don’t just craft world-class timepieces — we define their global value.

To scale our centralized pricing strategy from our Berlin office, we are looking for a Junior Global Pricing Manager (m/f/d) to join our team.

In this role, you will transition from analysis to action. Further, you will play a key part in designing and refining the pricing strategies across our luxury product segments. You won't just follow a template, you will actively help build the analytical framework and tools that shape our global pricing decisions.

Collaborating closely with our manufactory in Saxony and our market teams worldwide, bridge the gap between local market dynamics and global brand strategy. If you love translating complex data into sustainable business growth, this is your place to shine.

We are looking forward to sharing our passion for fine watchmaking with you!

Your Key Responsibilities


Drive and co-create the global pricing strategy for our masterpiece timepieces
Analyze global market data to identify growth potential and define innovative pricing models
Stake-holder-oriented communication of new internal and external information
Audience-focused tailoring of complex business cases in alignment with the brand’s strategic priorities across multiple departments


Your Skills


University degree (M. Sc., B.Sc.) in business administration, management and data science or statistics
Strong affinity towards business relevant tools (MS-Excel, Power BI (incl. DAX function), SAP BW or Google Looker & PowerPoint)
Not afraid of working with complex data (e.g. Sales data, Client data) and managing it in a business relevant tool (e.g. Excel, BI-Tool…)
High motivation for continuous growth in data analytic applications and ERP-Systems
A collaborative mindset with the ability to communicate complex data clearly across diverse cultures
Willingness to learn the fine watchmaking business with diligence
Good command of German and English
First experiences in pricing, definition of pricing strategies and/or sales analysis in an international operating system is a plus


This Is a Plus


Basic understanding of SAP (in particular: SD, MM) infrastructure
Knowledge of corresponding cross-process requirements of product pricing and supply chain requirements in an ERP-Environment


Our Benefits


Attractive and above-tariff remuneration: Including 13th salary, bonus, €50 shopping voucher per month and much more
Modern workplace: In the heart of Berlin; one of the sought-after work addresses.
Work-life balance: Through a 37-hour workweek, more flexible working time models, sabbaticals and the option to work from home.
Focus on health care: ergonomic workplaces, monthly health allowance, job bike and much more.
Family-friendly: monthly support of €100 for daycare costs per child and other individual offers to help you balance work and family.
Various development opportunities: For specialist and management careers using a variety of formats: coaching, face-to-face courses, online platforms etc.
Be part of a strong team working at eye level: Extensive onboarding and a strong team-spirit will help you to dive into the job.
Join a company rich in tradition: Regional excellence at A. Lange & Söhne and international collaboration with the Richemont Group enrich your daily work experience.


You can expect a challenging task in a modern company of the Richemont Group. Become part of our success story and leave your mark. Enrich a team that passionately and with a strong sense of community carries the work of Ferdinand A. Lange into the future - true to our motto "Never stand still".

We value diversity and welcome all applications – regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age, and sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application documents and your salary expectations for this position and what motivates you to join the Lange Family.

Please click on "Apply Now". We look forward to hearing from you.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
The Role:




Brook Green Supply (BGS) is a leading independent B2B gas and electricity supplier, delivering tailored energy supply and Net-Zero solutions to industrial and commercial consumers.




As a Senior Data Analyst, you will use advanced SQL and analytical skills to extract, transform and interpret data from large relational databases. You will design intuitive dashboards that turn complex data into clear, actionable insight, helping the business understand performance, identify trends, spot risks and opportunities, and make informed decisions.




You will ensure data accuracy and integrity by developing efficient SQL scripts for analysis, reporting and troubleshooting. Working closely with Data Engineers and the wider Tech team, you will streamline data processes, contribute to data models and provide insight that supports business decision-making.




This role suits an ambitious, flexible and technically strong analyst who enjoys explaining the story behind the data, improving reporting quality and helping colleagues use data with confidence.




Essential Functions of the Job:




Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data requirements and understand business needs.
Write, optimise and maintain complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation and analysis across large datasets.
Clean, analyse and transform large and complex datasets into accurate, actionable information.
Identify trends, patterns and correlations in data to uncover insights that support business decision-making.
Perform ad hoc data analysis and provide clear recommendations based on findings.
Produce visually clear, engaging and user-friendly dashboards.
Validate data accuracy and quality to support reliable reporting.
Stay up to date with industry trends and best practice in data visualisation and analytics.
Present findings and insights to stakeholders in a clear and concise way.
Coach and mentor colleagues and new starters on data topics, helping the business unlock greater value from data.
Support improvements to data processes, reporting models and analytical ways of working.







Skills & Experience Required:




Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, with a focus on data visualisation using Tableau.
Strong knowledge of SQL, with Python, R or similar programming languages desirable.
Demonstrated ability to write and optimise complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation and analysis.
Experience working with large, structured datasets and producing accurate reporting outputs.
Strong technical background, with excellent analytical skills and high attention to detail.
Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex information to non-technical stakeholders.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and confidence working across multiple web-based platforms.
Experience using a CRM system is desirable.
Degree-level education in a numerical subject, with a STEM degree desirable.
Self-starter who takes ownership, creates solutions and improves business processes.
Able to work independently and as part of a team, prioritising workload effectively with minimal supervision.
Able to coach and mentor colleagues across the business on data topics.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and responding to changing business needs.
Experience in the electricity or gas industry is not required, but is preferred.
Interest in developing knowledge across commercial decision-making, wholesale markets, non-commodities, forecasting, analytics and energy regulation.




Brook Green Supply is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, fairness of treatment, dignity and respect, and the elimination of all forms of discrimination in the workplace for all employees/contractors and job applicants.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Growth
Description:
Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.

Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.

For everyone, everywhere.

Job Description

More about our mission and what we offer.

Your Mission

At Wise, we’ve got a clear mission — money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives. As a FinTech company moving billions of GBP of customer money in over 70 countries, Wise needs bulletproof financials & insights into the growth of the company. We need timely, accurate and scalable financial data to make accurate business decisions inside the company.

Due to continued and rapid growth we’re on the hunt for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Growth and Strategic Finance Team in London. You’ll be part of the team that helps pilot the rocket ship.

What You’ll Be Doing


Your principal responsibility will be to generate insights that lead us to better decisions for the company and our customers
Curating datasets, surfacing metrics, some statistical modelling, and deeper dive analysis that we expect to influence the direction of the team and the company
Depending on the project you’re working on, you’ll doing the following:
Helping us understand what’s driving our growth at a company or regional level
Understand our customer segments and cohorts, and how they contribute to our growth
Tie our customer acquisition and activity to marketing or product initiatives, to measure the realised financial return of those initiatives

Who You Are


3 years experience in similar roles
Mathematical or quantitative background
Strong SQL skills
Familiarity with Python/R
Strong analytical ability
Decent understanding of stats and statistical modelling
Data visualisation and storytelling ability
Ability to self organise and manage stakeholders
Demonstration of impact/going above and beyond basic role requirements


Desirable


DBT
Data modelling in a warehouse context
Understanding of testing and experimental design
Legally authorised to work in the UK


Please note that Wise does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

Additional Information

Some Of Our Benefits

Base salary of £60,000 - £85,000

RSU's in a growing and public company

Private Medical Insurance + Life Insurance

️ Discounted gym memberships and cycle to work scheme

️ A paid 6-week sabbatical leave after four years

26 weeks maternity leave at full pay

An annual self-development budget

Pet friendly offices

‍♀️ Lots of fun group activities like yoga, running and boardgame nights

Find out more about our benefits in our London office.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Company: University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
Description:
We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Senior Business Intelligence Analyst with excellent technical and communication skills to join the Business Intelligence Team in the Surgery and Cancer Board.

We provide accurate, timely and complex analytical support to the Board, turning data into meaningful information that all aspects of the business (quality, access standards, productivity, activity, income, research) can utilise to make evidence-based decisions and drive improvements. As such, strong Excel skills, an attention to detail and the ability to expertly interrogate relational databases using SQL is essential. Experience of Power BI is also desirable. Applicants should also be experienced in communicating with technical and non-technical colleagues and be able to cater analytical products to a wide range of audiences. Statistical analysis skills or openness to learn is also desirable.

Whilst the post holder will work closely with the Business Intelligence Partners they should be able to work autonomously, and with minimal supervision where required. The ideal candidate will also possess the ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple and competing priorities to meet agreed deadlines.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a passionate and dedicated team.

University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) is one of the most complex NHS trusts in the UK, serving a large and diverse population. We provide academically led acute and specialist services, to people from the local area, from throughout the United Kingdom and overseas. Our vision is to deliver top-quality patient care, excellent education, and world-class research.

We provide first-class acute and specialist services across eight sites:


University College Hospital (incorporating the Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing)
National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery
Royal National ENT and Eastman Dental Hospitals
University College Hospital Grafton Way Building
Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine
University College Hospital Macmillan Cancer Centre
The Hospital for Tropical Diseases
University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street


We are dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of many complex illnesses. UCLH specialises in women’s health and the treatment of cancer, infection, neurological, gastrointestinal and oral disease. It has world class support services including critical care, imaging, nuclear medicine and pathology.

We are committed to sustainability and have pledged to become a carbon net zero health service, embedding sustainable practice throughout UCLH. We have set an ambitious target of net zero for our direct emissions by 2031 and indirect emissions by 2040.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience

Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:

  • Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
  • Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
  • Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
  • Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
  • Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
  • Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
  • Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
  • Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.

At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience

  • Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
  • Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
  • Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
  • Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
  • Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
  • Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
  • Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
  • Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
  • Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
  • Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
  • Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
  • Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.

Education

  • Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role

As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in helping the business make better use of its data. Working at the intersection of data, technology, and business operations, you will transform complex information into meaningful insights that support informed decision-making across the organisation.

You will be responsible for overseeing the delivery of data solutions through processes such as extracting, cleansing, and transforming data from a variety of business systems, including property management and financial platforms. By ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and accessible, you will help create a trusted foundation for reporting and analysis.

Working closely with colleagues across Property Management,Accounts, Building Consultancy, and other service lines, you will scope and deliver data-driven solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual reporting processes, and enhance access to business-critical information.

The role offers a balance of technical and stakeholder-facing responsibilities. You will analyse large and often complex datasets,identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities, before translating your findings into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

As part of a growing Data Analytics function, you will also contribute to the development of data standards, governance frameworks, and best practices while helping to foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture.

What Matters Most In This Role

Success in this role will be driven by your ability to combine strong technical capability with commercial awareness. You will be comfortable working with large datasets, developing scalable solutions, and ensuring data accuracy at every stage of the analytical process.

Equally important is your ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively. You should be able to translate complex data findings into straightforward recommendations that support decision-making and create value for stakeholders across the business.

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, proactive,and solutions-focused. You will enjoy identifying opportunities for improvement, embracing new technologies, and continuously looking for ways to enhance reporting, analytics,and business processes.

Other Duties Will Include


Building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports that provide timely, accurate visibility of key business metrics.
Creating and managing structured datasets, semantic models,and reusable query logic to support reporting requirements.
Supporting the ongoing development of Microsoft Fabric solutions, including data warehouses, Lakehouses, and semantic models.
Contributing to the development and maintenance of data standards, documentation, and governance processes.
Participating in knowledge-sharing activities, peer reviews, and collaborative problem-solving within the Data Analytics team.
Monitoring developments in data analytics technologies and recommending innovative approaches that add value to the business.


What We Expect Of You

You will have 2-3 years' experience in a Data Analyst or similar data-focused role, with a proven track record of delivering analytical outputs that support business decisions.

You will possess strong SQL skills and be confident writing, optimising, and troubleshooting queries against relational databases independently. A solid working knowledge of Python is also important.

You will have hands-on experience using Power BI, including DAX, alongside advanced Excel skills for reporting, analysis,and dashboard creation. Experience working with semantic models and centralised data platforms would be advantageous.

Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric is highly desirable, including familiarity with OneLake, Data Warehouses, Lakehouses, pipelines,shortcuts, and semantic models within the Fabric ecosystem.

You will demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and delivery.

You will be a strong communicator and collaborative team player,capable of building relationships with stakeholders at all levels while also taking ownership of your own projects. A willingness to learn,adapt, and contribute to a growing analytics function is essential, and an interest in the commercial property sector would be beneficial.

Why Workman?

Hybrid working to offer you a great work life balance, with a minimum of three days in the office.

Core working hours to allow for added flexibility and helps ease your commute to the office.

Study support

Discretionary annual bonus and salary reviews.

Healthcare, life insurance & wellness programme.

Long service additional holidays, your birthday off and an extra day between Christmas and New Year.

Lifestyle benefits to suit you: gym membership, cycle to work, buy and sell holiday to name just a few.

Social events throughout the year including a firm wide Christmas party!

Generous referral bonus.

As the UK's leading independent commercial property management specialist, Workman has an enviable position within the property industry.

We are proud of our longstanding relationships with many of our clients, some of whom we have worked with for more than 25 years. Our clients include leading institutional and sector-specialist investors, private property companies, public sector bodies and a growing number of overseas investors.

We pride ourselves on the caliber of our employees and their unique skill sets.
