Title: Data Analyst/Analytic Engineer, Business Transformation
Description:
Job Description

We are seeking an Intermediate Data Analyst to support the evolution of analytics across the Sawmills Division. This role will help deliver reporting modernization initiatives, migrate reporting assets from legacy platforms, develop Power BI solutions, and contribute to emerging digital twin, AI and automation capabilities.

The successful candidate is a curious problem-solver who enjoys working with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights while developing expertise in modern analytics platforms.

Responsibilities


Partner with business teams to understand reporting, analytics, AI or automation needs.
Gather business requirements and translate them into reporting, data engineering, AI agent or automation solutions.
Support the development and testing of AI-enabled and automated solutions by validating data, documenting requirements, and assisting with user adoption activities.
Contribute to PowerBI semantic model engineering, data transformation processes, and reporting standards.
Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, visualizations, semantic models
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and data pipeline troubleshooting activities.
Support digital twin initiatives through engineering, validation, reporting development, testing activities, and user adoption support.
Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to simplify and modernize reporting processes.
Support the migration of reporting solutions from Cognos and Tableau to ReportsNow and Power BI (sunset period)


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
2-5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or reporting.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, and data visualization best practices.
Understanding of data modeling and reporting concepts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.
Experience with Tableau, Cognos, Alteryx, or Microsoft Fabric is considered an asset.
Interest in AI, automation, and emerging analytics technologies.

Title: Data Analyst, Corporate Human Resources
Description:
Job Description

We are seeking a customer‑focused Data Analyst to join our Corporate Human Resources team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on turning data into actionable insights, enjoys engaging with stakeholders, and is passionate about empowering others to advance their analytics capabilities. You will contribute to building our enterprise data foundation—including the development of our data lake, secure data access, and advanced reporting—and support analytics across the HR function. The role also involves applying AI technologies and building analytical agents to automate insights and enhance decision‑making. The salary range for this position is between $60,000 - $85,500 annually.

Responsibilities


Partner with business and leaders to understand operational challenges and develop data‑driven solutions that support strategic decision‑making.
Act as a trusted advisor, educating internal customers on analytics tools, data literacy, and best practices for self‑service and data‑informed thinking.
Support the development and evolution of the enterprise data lake, including defining requirements, validating datasets, and enabling downstream analytics.
Manage user security and access controls to maintain governed, appropriate data access.
Deliver analytics and reporting across Human Resources, providing visibility into performance, risks, and trends.
Build and deploy AI‑powered analytics capabilities, including agents that automate data processing, summarize insights, and augment reporting workflows.
Lead requirements‑gathering sessions and translate business needs into effective reporting and visualization solutions.
Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI and Alteryx.
Analyze complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that influence business decisions and initiative selection.
Identify opportunities to automate, optimize, and standardize data and analytics processes.
Support data governance practices including data quality, integrity, metadata standards, and stewardship.
Mentor colleagues on interpreting data, leveraging analytics, and applying emerging AI tools effectively.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in analytics, data management, or business analysis.
Experience applying AI in a business context, including building or deploying AI agents.
Experience working with data lakes, data pipelines, or enterprise data platforms is an asset.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
Proficiency in Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, and Excel.
Ability to explain complex analytical and AI concepts in clear, engaging ways for non‑technical audiences.
Strong problem‑solving abilities and a creative, innovative approach to analytics.
Background in statistics, Lean, or Six Sigma is an asset.


About Us

Founded in 1882, J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) operates in Eastern Canada (New-Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Québec, Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador), as well as in USA. We are a team of 20,000 dedicated employees. At J.D. Irving, Limited, you are part of a dynamic team of professionals who lead with integrity and are passionate about delivering results. With a culture that nurtures talent and creates an inclusive workplace, you can grow your career across our various operating divisions.

We are committed to creating accessible environments for our colleagues, candidates, and customers. Requests for accommodation due to a disability (which may be visible or invisible, temporary, or permanent) can be made at any stage of application and employment. We encourage candidates to make their accommodation needs known so that we can provide equitable opportunities.

Worried you do not meet all the requirements? Studies have shown that many applicants apply only to job opportunities when they feel they meet 100% of the criteria. We promote an inclusive environment where everyone is appreciated, recognized, and empowered to contribute fully. If you are interested in this position but are worried you did not meet all the requirements, we would encourage you to still apply.

Our recruitment advisors and hiring teams will utilize human screening combined with AI technology to help identify the skills and qualities that matter most to our business, while safeguarding your privacy and using AI responsibly.

We appreciate your interest in our company however only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Irving Business Services is a vital support function within J.D. Irving, Limited, delivering expertise in essential areas such as Finance, Human Resources, Supply Chain, Health and Safety, Communications, and Legal.

By managing resources, delivering fast and flexible outcomes, and fostering innovation, Irving Business Services plays a critical role in driving operational success and supporting the company’s long-term strategic goals. Title: Data Analyst, Investment Data Management
Description:
Interested in joining one of Canada’s top performing asset managers? We are looking for a Data Analyst for an existing vacancy on our Investment Data Management (IDM) team. The IDM Team resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group Ltd. (CCLFG) manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the Data Management Team for a variety of functions from the front office to the back. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continues to grow enterprise wide. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment. Our offices currently operate on a hybrid model with a combination of in-office and remote working days throughout the week.

What You Will Do


Maintain and validate accuracy of equity/fixed income/derivative data across multiple systems/databases to enable Investment Manager modeling, trading, and risk monitoring.
Manage and enable a myriad of scheduled processes for vendor systems, internal and market data transfers, valuation, and benchmarking data inputs to the investment process.
Deliver timely data signoffs to investment teams; develop and analyze data-quality exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
Provide analysis on operational needs, ad-hoc data/data-history requests for multiple business partners to support pre- and post-trade portfolio management functions.
Identify process/workflow improvements to increase operational efficiency, mitigate risk, improve data-quality, and increase service levels provided to stakeholders.
Supporter of other operational or engineering staff, senior or managers on a variety of ad-hoc tasks and projects.


What You Bring


You have a degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, Business Operations, or a related field. Relevant designation, such as the MBA, CFA, or FRM is an asset.
2-6 years of relevant experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset
You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues in data and technology.
You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively to team/cross-team members, and upward to key stakeholders.
You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail.
You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects.


The salary range for this position is $60,000-$90,000. The salary range provided reflects the base salary range for this position as required by legislation. In addition, there is an annual performance bonus which contributes to the total compensation for this position. Further questions may be directed to the HR team during the interview process.

  

For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com. 

CC&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. 

Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team - AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

Title: M5 Process Analyst
Description:
Reporting to the Manager of Fleet and Facility Analytics and M5 Support. This position monitors data interfaces between M5, SAP, and other applications (e.g., ROB, P6) to identify and investigate data errors, requiring advanced knowledge of databases, SQL, and systems management. Using specialized skills and advanced analytical techniques, it works alongside OCT to ensure key interfaces supporting billing, payroll, and supply chain function effectively.

This role optimizes the use of the M5 system to align with Fleet Services and City business needs by designing aligned business processes. Additionally, it serves as a point of contact for Assetworks Fleet Management Information System (M5) user support, handling inquiry resolution, issue investigation, access management, and advice.

This position is also responsible for reviewing and verifying payroll data prior to transfer to the payroll system, collaborating with supervisors and timekeepers to resolve time reporting issues, and post-transfer data validation. It requires strong data skills and understanding of payroll rules across 3 unions.

What will you do?


Guide users on navigating system features, screens, dashboards, and reporting tools
Update user documentation following software upgrades to reflect layout updates and enable adoption of new features
Manage user access administration, including provisioning new accounts, adjusting roles, disabling departing user profiles, and handling password resets
Respond to user inquiries, offer system usage guidance, and develop operational workarounds independently or in coordination with the Fleet Information System Administrator, end users, or vendor support
Serve as the primary contact for M5 interface operations, maintaining real-time and batch integrations with core COE systems (e.g., SAP, PeopleSoft, ROB)
Escalate complex interface issues to OCT when unresolvable internally by the Fleet Information Administrator
Evaluate integration requirements, prepare technical specifications, and conduct impact testing for core system updates or new M5 releases
Monitor interface management tools to resolve transmission errors and collaborate with staff to rectify data rejection causes
Review employee-reported hours for completeness, verify statutory holiday pay accuracy, and resolve issues before data is loaded into the payroll system via the interface. A strong knowledge of the 3 union Collective Bargaining Agreements and their payroll rules is essential
Collaborate with branch supervisors and timekeepers to ensure payroll time approvals are completed prior to pass-off, and provide guidance on handling exceptional situations
Reconcile payroll data between the Fleet System and the payroll system post-pass-off to confirm successful data uploads
Apply requested adjustments in the payroll system after pass-off and prior to the payroll cutoff deadline
Audit billing and system data to uncover business process or system errors affecting data quality
Pinpoint user behaviors resulting in data discrepancies and offer recommendations for training and coaching support
Log support tickets with the software vendor upon detecting system bugs causing errors
Assist frontline staff with proper data entry to maintain data integrity and facilitate smooth interface data transfers
Analyze business process challenges against system functionality to identify conflicts, partner with stakeholders on solution development, lead testing, and perform necessary analysis to ensure resolution
Perform related duties as assigned



Qualifications:


University Degree in a related discipline such as Computer Science or Information Technology and 2 years of relevant experience in an Information Technology environment. Formal certification in the area of expertise is desirable
Minimum of 2 years of experience directly related to database querying, managing computer interfaces, data analysis and troubleshooting system issues
Oracle SQL is required



Assets:


Experience with SAP interfaces and M5 are assets
Experience in a Fleet environment is an asset



Skills required for success:


Knowledge of work methods, practices and terminology related to the Fleet Management Service industry and Fleet Management databases
Strong capability to bridge customer requirements and technical system specifications when resolving complex issues
Proficiency in conducting thorough research, rigorous testing, and comprehensive documentation
Aptitude for evaluating program interdependencies to deliver actionable, well-reasoned recommendations
Proven communication and collaborative skills
Skill in auditing extensive datasets (e.g., billing files) to maintain data accuracy and completeness
Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and data extraction tools including SQL Developer, Crystal Reports, and Tableau
Solid project management abilities, with a focus on prioritizing work to consistently meet operational deadlines
Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and contribute effectively within a team setting
Alignment to our Cultural Commitments and Leadership Competencies ( https://bit.ly/4brRrXm )
Embracing a culture of equity, diversity, reconciliation and inclusion



Conditions of Employment:


This position will work out of a facility that is not accessible via public transportation. A valid Class 5 license and access to personal transportation is recommended



Work Environment:


Note: This position may be eligible for a hybrid work arrangement with the flexibility to work from both home and the worksite as per the Letter of Understanding between the City of Edmonton and Civic Service Union 52
The weekly hours of work for this position are currently under review and may change at a future time. Any changes will be made in accordance with the City of Edmonton/Civic Service Union 52 collective agreement and the incumbent will be notified in advance

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: Vancouver / Toronto / Remote in Canada | Employment Type: Full-time |

Reports to: Senior Data Analyst, Team Lead

Reporting to Senior Data Analyst, Team Lead, we're looking for a curious and collaborative Data Analyst (Survey Tabulations) to join Reach3 Insights. In this role, you'll help turn survey data into accurate, decision-ready cross-tabulations, working with smart, kind people who love turning human insights into clear stories, stronger decisions, and better customer experiences.

This role is open to candidates based in Canada, with a remote working model designed to support connection, focused work, and real life outside of work.

About Reach3 Insights

Reach3 Insights is a full-service research consultancy that helps modern brands move faster and get closer to their customers through mobile-first, conversational research. We design immersive, in-the-moment research programs, pair them with smart data science and dynamic storytelling, and turn insight into action.

As part of Rival Group — alongside Rival Technologies and Angus Reid — we're helping transform the insights industry through AI-accelerated, messaging-based conversational insights. Our work reaches consumers and business audiences in ways that feel fresh, human, and genuinely useful.

We work with ambitious teams and global brands, and we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll find a team that values trust, curiosity, ownership, creativity, and having a good time while doing meaningful work.

What you'll own


Produce accurate, well-formatted cross-tabulations from survey data using WinCross, SPSS, Microsoft Excel, and other relevant tools; review questionnaires and tabulation plans, clarify requirements, and deliver accurate outputs.
Complete rigorous quality checks on survey data and tables, investigate discrepancies, collaborate to resolve issues, and advise researchers on how to structure and interpret analysis outputs across different survey methods and designs.
Plan and prioritize work in ClickUp, track output, and improve turnaround time, accuracy, and productivity by testing AI and emerging tools, recommending process improvements, supporting new tool rollouts, and maintaining training and process documentation.


What you bring


At least 2 years of professional experience preparing, transforming, and tabulating market research survey data, plus a university or college degree or graduate certificate in market research, analytics, statistics, economics, social sciences, or another field involving research methods and data analysis.
Hands-on proficiency with SPSS and WinCross, strong Microsoft Excel skills, and experience working with survey datasets and producing cross-tabulations.
Clear, concise written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach when working with local and remote teammates and research stakeholders.
A proactive, curious approach to change and ambiguity, with the judgment to test new ideas responsibly, evaluate their impact, and continuously improve data analysis workflows.
The ability to prioritize high-impact work, manage competing deadlines, stay organized, and consistently deliver accurate, high-quality outputs in a fast-moving environment.
Accountability for goals and deliverables, with the ability to work independently, collaborate effectively as part of a team, and bring a positive, solutions-oriented mindset as priorities evolve.


Nice to have


Familiarity with questionnaires, table specifications, banners, filters, and weighting is an asset.
Experience working in market research or public opinion research is preferred.


Why Reach3 for your next career adventure?

At Reach3, how we work matters just as much as what we deliver. We're building a place where people can do meaningful work, grow their careers, partner with great clients, and enjoy the humans they work with along the way.

Fair compensation: We're committed to pay equity and fair pay practices. The salary range for this role is $65,000 to $85,000, with final compensation based on skills, experience, and internal equity.


Home office, internet, and cellphone stipends
Retirement savings with employer matching
Parental leave top-up


Flexibility and time off: Flexible ways of working, home office support, and comprehensive paid time off so you can recharge and do your best work.


Hybrid or remote working model, depending on role and location
Comprehensive paid time off
Volunteer and professional development days


Health and wellness: Benefits that support the whole human, not just the employee.


Competitive health, vision, and dental benefits
Health spending account
Generous sick, personal, and mental health days
Additional health benefits with Canada Life


Our values

Our values guide how we work together, make decisions, and show up for customers and each other:


Courage
Results
Energy
Kinship


The not-so-fine print

You must be eligible to work in Canada to be considered for this role. At Reach3, we value the unique qualities and experiences each candidate brings. We personally review every application and do not use AI or automated systems to screen or filter resumes.

If you don't see yourself fully reflected in every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. Research shows that people from underrepresented groups often apply only when they feel 100% qualified. Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking.
Integrity: We do the right thing every time.
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results.
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes.
Service: We serve customers, communities and colleagues.


If you value what we value, and like the perks along the way – Apply TODAY!

The employment offer is contingent upon completion of a successful background check.

HUB is a company where your contributions will make a difference. We invite you to learn more about our team at www.hubinternational.com. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to hcw.hr@hubinternational.com to request this. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Department Business Operations

Required Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience

Required Travel: No Travel Required

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the recruiting team HUBRecruiting@hubinternational.com. We’re looking for an experienced, highly independent analytics engineer to join our Revenue Analytics team. This team owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that support Affirm’s Revenue organization.

About The Role

In this role, you will lead the development of scalable, trusted data products for Affirm’s revenue teams. You turn ambiguous business and technical problems into scalable solutions across data modeling, metrics, dashboards, automation, governance, and AI enablement. You will help set the technical direction for Revenue’s data layer, establish the semantic and metadata foundations required for AI, and raise the quality and impact of data across the Revenue organization.

What You’ll Do


Lead high-impact data product initiatives for Revenue, from ambiguous problem definition through technical design, implementation, rollout, and adoption.
Advance AI initiatives within the Revenue data ecosystem by identifying high-value use cases, integrating AI into analytics engineering workflows, and establishing the semantic, metadata, context, quality, and evaluation foundations required for AI.
Design and build durable, well-tested data products that power revenue operations, field and executive reporting, external merchant reporting, and analyst self-service.
Set technical direction for Revenue’s data layer across dbt models, metrics, semantic structures, documentation, lineage, testing, governance, and access controls.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale Revenue Analytics through improved data architecture, tooling, governance, and enablement.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to analysts and cross-functional partners, raising the bar for how data products are designed, built, and maintained.


What We Look For


7+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data engineering, data product development, or a related technical analytics role.
Deep expertise in SQL, dbt, data modeling, metrics design, data quality, documentation, and modern analytics engineering practices.
Strong working knowledge of BI tools such as Sigma, Looker, or Tableau, cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, and modern data platforms such as Databricks.
Strong understanding of the foundations required for reliable AI—including semantic layers, metadata, evaluations, documentation, lineage, access controls, and data quality—and experience applying AI tools within analytics engineering workflows.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, ambiguous projects by defining scope, sequencing work, managing tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and delivering durable technical solutions.
Experience designing scalable data products for multiple audiences and influencing technical and non-technical stakeholders around architecture and product direction.
Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial, GTM, revenue, or sales operations teams.

Equity Grade - 6

Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking.
Integrity: We do the right thing every time.
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results.
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes.
Service: We serve customers, communities and colleagues.


If you value what we value, and like the perks along the way – Apply TODAY!

The employment offer is contingent upon completion of a successful background check.

HUB is a company where your contributions will make a difference. We invite you to learn more about our team at www.hubinternational.com. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to hcw.hr@hubinternational.com to request this. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Required Travel: No Travel Required

Title: Portfolio Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Accelerate your success at Colliers.

Why Colliers?

As one of Canada’s leading commercial real estate services firms, we are driven by our mission to accelerate success for our people, clients, and communities.

A career at Colliers gives you the opportunity to make an impact, advance your career, and collaborate with top-tier talent. Don’t just take our word for it – we’ve been recognized as a top employer on a number of prestigious lists, including Best Workplaces in Canada, Best Workplaces for Women, Best Workplaces with Most Trusted Executive Teams, among others.

Toronto, ON / Vancouver, BC; Hybrid

About The Role

The Portfolio Intelligence Analyst is responsible for producing trusted portfolio intelligence that enables effective enterprise portfolio management and informed executive decision-making. Reporting to the Enterprise Portfolio Manager, the role gathers, validates, analyses and maintains portfolio information across the enterprise technology portfolio. The Portfolio Intelligence Analyst develops executive dashboards, portfolio analytics, governance information and performance reporting while supporting portfolio planning, investment prioritization, and ongoing portfolio monitoring.

The role ensures portfolio information is complete, accurate, timely, and decision-ready, providing the analytical foundation upon which portfolio governance, investment decisions and executive reporting are based.

In this role, you will…

Portfolio Analysis and Intelligence


Analyze portfolio data to support prioritization, investment planning, capacity management, financial oversight, dependency management, and portfolio health assessments.
Develop actionable insights, identify trends, risks, and data anomalies, and provide recommendations to support strategic decision-making.


Executive Reporting and Governance Support


Develop and maintain executive dashboards, scorecards, portfolio reports, governance packs, and performance metrics.
Support governance forums by preparing briefing materials, decision-support information, meeting documentation, and tracking governance actions and outcomes.
Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, consistent, and tailored for executive audiences.


Business Case and Investment Support


Support business case intake, validation, investment appraisal, and enterprise portfolio prioritization activities.
Maintain business case repositories and associated supporting documentation.


Portfolio Health Monitoring & Continuous Improvement


Monitor portfolio financial performance, resource utilization, delivery health, risks, dependencies, benefits realization, and key portfolio metrics.
Maintain high standards of data quality and information integrity across the portfolio.
Identify and implement improvements to portfolio analytics, reporting, processes, automation, and AI-enabled portfolio intelligence capabilities.


What You Bring


Basic / Minimum Education requirement to perform the job: Bachelor's degree
Preferred educational requirements to perform the job:
Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
SAFe® Lean Portfolio Management (LPM)
SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM)
Kanban Management Professional (KMP)
Management of Portfolios (MoP®)
PRINCE2® Foundation
Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300)
Relevant Years of experience required to perform the role: 3 to 5 yrs of experience
Experience working within project, program, or Agile frameworks is an asset and preferred
Commercial Real Estate experience / background to perform the role is preferred

Pursuant to local law, Colliers is disclosing the following information:

Area/Location Specific: Toronto, ON & Vancouver, BC

Approximate Compensation Range for this Role: $95,887 to $110,000

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all national locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This posting is for an existing vacancy within our organization.

Colliers does not use AI-enabled tools to sort or decline applications. All decisions are made by our talent acquisition team.

What We Offer

Innovative projects: Work on cutting-edge initiatives that shape our communities, drive our growth, and make a tangible impact.

Career growth: Advance your career and achieve your goals with industry-leading training and development programs.

Competitive benefits & compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and flexible benefits package along with competitive compensation that rewards your contributions and supports your well-being.

Collaborative culture: Join our enterprising team where innovation thrives, collaboration is key, and our people are empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Our robust North American Diversity & Inclusion Program features eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), where you can connect, learn, and contribute to a diverse and supportive community. Learn more: https://www.collierscanada.com/en-ca/careers/diversity-and-inclusion

Global network: Join a global team of 24,000 professionals across 70 countries, where you'll expand your network and learn from experts in a dynamic international community. Accelerate your career and enhance your expertise as you connect and collaborate with top talent around the world.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Powerex Corp. is the wholly owned energy marketing subsidiary of BC Hydro, responsible for marketing clean electricity across North America. We are seeking an experienced Quantitative Analyst with a background in Operations Research to join our Analytics team. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep analytical expertise with strong programming skills and a passion for applying both to complex, real-world energy market problems. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, self-driven, and comfortable delivering rigorous analysis in a fast-paced trading environment.

Reporting to the Director, Analytics, you will work closely with traders and senior analysts to support Front Office operations through mathematical modelling, deal valuation, data analysis, and tool development. Your primary function will be to support and maintain existing mathematical programming models and to develop new ones from concept to implementation. This position will be relied upon to support the achievement of our purpose and long-term goals by fostering our values: teamwork, accountability, integrity, service, ingenuity, and safety.

Key Responsibilities


Maintain and enhance existing mathematical programming models, ensuring reliability, accuracy, and alignment with evolving business needs
Design and develop new quantitative models from concept through to implementation, applying operations research techniques to real-world energy market problems
Perform deal valuation and quantitative analysis to support Front Office trading decisions
Build and maintain analytical tools and data pipelines that support trading operations and workflows
Conduct data analysis using large datasets, extracting insights that inform trading strategy and risk assessment
Collaborate with traders, analysts, and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Front Office tools, models, and processes through innovation and automation
Produce clear technical documentation and communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences
Support ad-hoc analytical requests while managing longer-term modelling projects in parallel



Qualifications

Required


Bachelor's degree in a field such as Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, or Statistics
At least five years of quantitative analytical work experience, a substantial portion of which has been specifically in operations research. Candidates without a formal operations research background will be considered provided they demonstrate sufficient quantitative and technical experience and aptitude
Demonstrated ability to solve challenging technical problems without the guarantee of adequate or perfect information, delivering both quick ad-hoc solutions and long-term in-depth models
Experience solving real-world problems by translating them into constraints represented by computer models
Strong grounding in probability and statistics, and the judgement to know which methods fit a given problem
Ability to explain quantitative reasoning to traders and commercial staff, and to defend it under challenge
Expert-level proficiency in MS Excel and at least one data visualization or dashboarding tool such as Tableau
Scripting experience in a mathematical programming language, ideally AMPL & CPLEX
Programming experience in at least one of VBA, Python, C++/C#, or SQL (Snowflake, dbt)
Proven experience working with large datasets and managing end-to-end data pipelines
Strong technical writing skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with both technical and business stakeholders
Ability to work independently, multi-task, and thrive under pressure in a fast-paced, open work environment



Preferred


A Master's degree in Operations Research or another analytical field, and/or successful completion of a professional development program such as a CFA
Experience in the energy industry
Experience working with LLMs such as Claude to support research and the development of tools, models, and data pipelines
Knowledge or experience in hydrology, hydropower engineering, time-series forecasting, or general data science



Work Arrangements & Other Requirements


Full-time, in-office position based at our Vancouver, BC office
Must be located in the Vancouver/Lower Mainland area
Must be legally authorized to work in Canada
A background check and references will be required for the position

At AFL, we're building more than networks – we're helping connect communities, businesses, and people across Canada. Our teams deliver the critical infrastructure that keeps people connected, businesses running, and communities moving forward. Behind everything we do is a commitment to ensuring every employee returns home safely every day.

We are seeking a motivated Business Data Analyst with hands‑on experience in business intelligence, data modeling, and a strong interest in process automation within the Microsoft ecosystem. The successful candidate will support end‑to‑end report development, from requirements gathering and data preparation to report design, deployment, and ongoing enhancement, using Power BI and other Power Platform and Microsoft 365 tools.

Under the general direction of the Reporting to the Manager of Data and Analytics, the Business Data Analyst will maintain and improve existing BI solutions while contributing to new initiatives that support accurate and timely reporting for internal and external stakeholders. The Business Data Analyst will work closely with cross functional teams and executives, leveraging strong communication and analytical skills to translate business needs into scalable, reliable data solutions, while using automation to enhance and optimize reporting and business processes.

What You Will Do


Support full lifecycle report development, including requirements gathering, data modeling, ETL, visualization, and deployment.
Design and maintain datasets, data models, and data extractions to support reporting needs across assigned business scopes and stakeholder groups.
Build and maintain Power BI datasets, reports, and dashboards using data modeling best practices.
Use Power Automate to streamline data refreshes, automate business processes, and optimize reporting workflows.
Connect to and manage data sources including SharePoint Lists and libraries, SQL databases, REST APIs, etc.
Identify data quality issues in source systems, collaborate with stakeholders to resolve them, and recommend improvements.
Partner with cross‑functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and reporting solutions.
Create and maintain technical documentation covering reports, datasets, ETL pipelines, data models, automations, and business processes to support long‑term sustainability and team knowledge retention.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on system optimization, automation, and reporting efficiency, including the adoption and integration of AI‑driven tools.
Follow and promote AFL’s environmental, health, and safety policies.


What You Bring


Hands‑on experience developing Power BI solutions (Desktop & Service) in a production or enterprise environment.
Experience in DAX, data modeling, and BI development workflows.
Experience using SharePoint as a data source (Lists, document libraries, folder connectors).
Experience or demonstrated interest in learning Microsoft Power Platform tools (Power Automate, Power Apps).
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to data accuracy, including the ability to normalize inconsistent client data for analytics‑ready ingestion.
Excellent communication skills for gathering business requirements and explaining technical concepts to non‑technical audiences.
Self‑driven, curious, and eager to learn new tools and technologies.
Process efficiency mindset with the ability to identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve existing workflows.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently or collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment.


Nice to Have


Experience using Microsoft Power Platform tools to support automation, workflow improvement, or data integration.
Experience developing Copilot agents using the Microsoft 365 Copilot app and Copilot Studio.
Background or domain experience in Telecommunications or Construction.


Working Conditions


Hybrid office environment
General hours of Monday through Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm
Some travel may be required


Additional Perks


Competitive salary
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.
RRSP or retirement savings matching.
Paid vacation and personal days.
Professional development and training support.
Hybrid work arrangements
Employee assistance program and wellness resources.
Collaborative, high-performing team environment.
Strong safety, quality, and continuous improvement culture.

Description:
Description

The Alexa Daily Essentials team delivers experiences critical to how customers interact with Alexa as part of daily life. Alexa users engage with our products across experiences connected to Timers, Alarms, Calendars, Food, and News. Our experiences include critical time saving techniques, ad-supported news audio and video, and in-depth kitchen guidance aimed at serving the needs of the family from sunset to sundown.

As a Data Scientist on our team, you'll work with complex data, develop statistical methodologies, and provide critical product insights that shape how we build and optimize our solutions. You will work closely with your Analytics and Applied Science teammates. You will build frameworks and mechanisms to scale data solutions across our organization. If you are passionate about redefining how AI can improves everyone's daily life, we’d love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

Problem-Solving


Analyze complex data to identify patterns, inform product decisions, and understand root causes of anomalies.
Develop analysis and modeling approaches to drive product and engineering actions to identify patterns, insights, and understand root causes of anomalies. Your solutions directly improve the customer experience.
Independently work with product partners to identify problems and opportunities. Apply a range of data science techniques and tools to solve these problems. Use data driven insights to inform product development. Work with cross-disciplinary teams to mechanize your solution into scalable and automated frameworks.


Data Infrastructure


Build data pipelines, and identify novel data sources to leverage in analytical work - both from within Alexa and from cross Amazon
Acquire data by building the necessary SQL / ETL queries


Communication


Excel at communicating complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences.
Build relationships with stakeholders and counterparts. Work with stakeholders to translate causal insights into actionable recommendations
Force multiply the work of the team with data visualizations, presentations, and/or dashboards to drive awareness and adoption of data assets and product insights
Collaborate with cross-functional teams. Mentor teammates to foster a culture of continuous learning and development


Basic Qualifications


2+ years of data scientist experience
2+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
2+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving
Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language
Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
Experience working on multi-team, cross-disciplinary projects
Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions
Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication

Title: Data Engineer & Analyst – Climate Risk & Data Strategy
Description:
Job Description

What is The Opportunity?

Join our Retail Credit technology team to drive the modernization of enterprise risk systems and climate data initiatives. You'll lead business and data analysis for our Climate Data Strategy and Innovation Technology portfolio—a strategic initiative to source data from multiple data sources – internal and external to RBC, build a robust storage framework, and enable advanced data modeling across the organization.

This role bridges business requirements and technology delivery, ensuring climate risk and data strategy projects translate complex requirements into actionable solutions for development and QA teams.

What Will You Do?


Lead all Data and Systems analysis activities for the Climate Data Risk & Strategy projects portfolio
Develop detailed knowledge of current-state data feeds for Climate Risk Data Stores and Climate Data Hub, working across PCAF Asset Classes (Residential Real Estate, Commercial Real Estate, Sovereign Debt, Project Finance, Listed Equity, Corporate Bonds, Business Loans, and Unlisted Equities)
Design and implement pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and storage while ensuring data consistency, lineage, and metadata management to support regulatory and governance needs.
Determine and map data transformation rules to standardize feeds from multiple sources into Climate Risk engines and Data Stores
Collaborate with business users to elicit data requirements and demonstrate system functionality
Create functional, non-functional and data specifications and conduct complex data analysis using AI/LLM models
Partner with development and QA teams to validate design assumptions, explain requirements, and create test cases and support UAT
Work with ESG & Risk Analytics teams to build data assets, models and calculation engines to produce Risk Metrics used in RBC Climate Risk Disclosures and to track RBC’s exposure to Physical Risk


What You Need to Succeed?

Must Have:


5+ years as a Data Engineer or Analyst, or in a technical/functional/consulting role in software development
Strong proficiency in Python (Pandas), ‘pySpark’ and SQL for complex data analysis
Ability with data catalogues, data modeling, and business process modeling and experience working on data projects using Agile methodologies (sourcing, standardization, and aggregation)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to document requirements, write specifications, and present findings to business and technical stakeholders
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Sciences, Technology, Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or related quantitative field


Nice to Have:


Knowledge of climate data initiatives and ESG investment policies/frameworks for financial institutions
Experience supporting developers with technology stacks such as Linux, Hadoop, Hive, and Spark
Exposure to using AI/LLM models embedded in tools such as Windsurf and Github Co-Pilot - AI-powered agentic coding assistants for analytical purposes
Experience with data in the finance, banking, or insurance industries


What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.


A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work

Business Appraisals, Business Process Modeling, Commercial Acumen, Communication, Critical Thinking, Group Problem Solving, Interpersonal Relationship Management, Requirements Analysis, Resource Management, Team Management

Description:
MatchBox Consulting Group is currently seeking a Data Analyst for a 12 month contract role at a client of ours located in Edmonton

Responsibilities


Maintain the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity of asset-related data across enterprise systems through data entry, validation, updating,reconciliation, and ongoing quality monitoring.
Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, gaps, and inconsistencies by collaborating with operations, engineering, field personnel, and other businessstakeholders.
Perform data stewardship activities to ensure compliance with established data standards, business rules, and governance requirements.
Support data governance initiatives by documenting data definitions, business processes, workflows, metadata, and data quality procedures.
Develop, monitor, and report on key data quality metrics and performance indicators to support continuous improvement and informed decision-making.
Maintain and update data reference libraries, asset hierarchies, standards documentation, and related governance artifacts.
Prepare, validate, and provide data sets and supporting documentation for audits, regulatory reporting, compliance activities, and business reporting requirements.
Analyze existing data management processes and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and data reliability.
Identify opportunities for workflow optimization and automation, leveraging appropriate tools and technologies to streamline data collection, maintenance, and reporting activities.
Develop user guides, training materials, and documentation to promote consistent data management practices and improve user adoption of standards and processes.
Provide guidance, coaching, and support to system users and business stakeholders regarding data standards, data quality expectations, and asset information management practices.
Collaborate with reporting and analytics teams to ensure underlying data structures, hierarchies, and datasets support business intelligence, reporting, and strategic planning requirements.
Participate in system enhancements, testing activities, and process improvement initiatives related to asset information and data management.
Support cross-functional projects and initiatives requiring data analysis, data validation, and asset information expertise.
Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.


Requirements:


Well-organized, fast learner and able to be flexible in delivery method as conditions warrant;
Knowledge of transmission and distribution asset construction means and methods;
Strong safety focus and the ability to lead by example to set the tone and direction for health and safety focus on projects;
Strong interpersonal and organizational skills;
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written;
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills;
Strong customer service focus;
Demonstrated initiative, creativity and integrity;
Excellent computer skills including Word, Excel, Outlook. Microsoft Power BI and
PowerPoint;
Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize and problem solve;
Good judgment and reasoning skills; and
Ability to work with limited direction and to function as a key team member.

Our mantra has always been the same, to approach cannabis in a socially responsible manner, ensuring we provide our customers with the best products, information and service to guide their cannabis experience. You'll manage the consistency and accuracy of data across systems, provide insights to the products and purchasing team, and partner cross-functionally with the operations group. A primary focus is ensuring data is analyzed and delivered to key stakeholders in a way that maximizes and empowers strategic decision-making. We're a cannabis company, and while previous cannabis-industry experience isn't required, an enthusiasm for learning about the industry and the product matters.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


- Manage the point-of-sale back end and data warehouse to ensure the consistency and quality of information


- Support the centralized ordering process for our growing network of stores across two provinces


- Provide support for demand planning and product performance analysis


- Maintain regular reports, interpreting data and results to provide analysis and insights


- Design and develop reports and KPI dashboards, aggregating data from multiple sources using Power BI and other data-visualization tools


- Identify, analyze and interpret trends and patterns in detailed data sets


- Communicate cross-functionally with different business units and experience levels to understand the big picture and facilitate healthy information flow


- Learn, continuously, and help others learn too
