- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (required)


- 2+ years in a Data Analytics, Supply Chain Management or Accounting / Finance capacity


- Proficiency in data manipulation and analysis using common enterprise tools (MS Excel, Power BI, data warehousing, queries, etc.)


- A fundamental problem-solving orientation, an eye for detail and a conscientious work ethic


- Analytical ability, deductive reasoning and critical-thinking skills with a focus on detail and accuracy


- Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally with internal and external stakeholders


- Results-oriented, with a focus on goal setting to meet and / or exceed budgets and KPI targets


- Strong communication and presentation skills, able to translate big ideas and complex market developments into digestible sound bites


- Experience in an inventory-management role (an asset)


- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (an asset)


WORK ENVIRONMENT


- This position operates in an office environment


PHYSICAL DEMANDS


- Occasional prolonged and irregular hours


- Repetitive hand motions; prolonged use of a computer


- Ability to maintain composure under periods of stress


TRAVEL


- Very minimal travel required

Title: Analyst, Business Analysis
Description:
The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves uncovering insights hidden in data? We’re looking for an Analyst, Business Analysis to join our Finance team within Insurance Services. In this role, you’ll collaborate with teams across AMA to turn complex information into meaningful insights that help guide sound business decisions. You’ll analyze trends, process and products, and bring clarity to big questions — all while helping us make smarter, data-driven choices that serve our members better. In this role, you will also be supporting the corporate reserving function, to support informed business decisions across pricing, underwriting, reinsurance, and capital management.

A Place to Belong

AMA is more than a workplace; it’s a family. Together, we help protect the things that matter most to our more than one-million members—everything from roadside safety to retail savings, food security to childhood well-being. And with operations that span automotive, registries, travel, insurance and more, the opportunities to grow with us are almost limitless!

About

Building on a century of proud service in Alberta communities, we’re passionate about making a meaningful difference in the places where we live and work. And that all begins with our people. As part of the AMA team, you’ll enjoy:


Competitive salary and flexible benefits
Employer-paid retirement savings program
Employee-exclusive discounts on travel, insurance, memberships, and more
Free travel medical insurance for you and your immediate family
Ongoing professional development
Paid vacation and personal days, including a Volunteer Day and Me Day
Flexible work models that make sense for your lifestyle


Who You Are


A curious, analytical thinker who loves solving complex problems with data.
A strong communicator who can translate numbers into meaningful business stories.
Naturally collaborative — you enjoy working across teams to find solutions that make an impact.
Detail-oriented, organized, and confident managing multiple priorities.
You thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment where innovation and teamwork drive results.


How You’ll Make An Impact


Provide data-driven support to guide action-oriented business decisions across AMA.
Analyze and interpret data from multiple sources to identify key trends and opportunities.
Develop and manage high-quality dashboards and reporting solutions that serve as a single source of truth.
Work closely with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather, validate, and refine business requirements.
Present findings and insights to leadership teams in clear, compelling ways.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of critical data.
Support the rollout of new business analytics tools and processes.


What You Bring To The Table


Bachelor’s degree in Actuarial Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in actuarial analysis, business intelligence, business analysis, or a related technical role.
Advanced working knowledge of SQL (including complex query writing).
Experience developing and managing BI solutions or dashboards using Power BI or similar tools.
Strong data visualization and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.

Actuarial reserving experience would be an asset.

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is looking to hire a permanent, full-time Procurement Data Specialist in Edmonton or Calgary who will report to the Procurement Performance Manager.

Responsibilities include collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers and Caterpillar to gather and process information requirements to facilitate the daily and long term requirements vital to the ERP system and identify value-added opportunities across the organization. Manage and optimize procurement data and systems by maintaining the integrity of supplier, item, and related master data within the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, while supporting overall system functionality and data architecture.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, support data analysis, and translate operational needs into system and process improvements that enhance procurement performance.
Support ERP systems and continuous improvement initiatives by contributing to system enhancements, configuration changes, and integration activities in collaboration with IT and cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Develop and maintain data governance standards by establishing data policies, controls, and best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, compliance, and system integrity across procurement processes.
Design and deliver reporting and insights by developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs to support decision-making, performance tracking, and operational visibility.
Provide mentorship and guidance to Procurement Data Coordinators and support cross-functional teams in data processes, reporting tools, and system usage.
Lead and contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to optimize procurement systems, workflows, and data processes, and ensuring initiatives are tracked through to completion.

Post-secondary degree in Business or Supply Chain, related to Data Management, Operations Management or related field
2+ years experience in a Data Management or Supply Chain role
Strong computer skills and proficient in MS Office Suite – specifically Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Experience with MS Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
Experience with analytics and the development of reports, metrics and dashboards using tools such as PowerBI
SQL and Excel (VBA) knowledge is an asset
Previous experience with SAP Ariba would be an asset
Knowledge and understanding of end-to-end supply chain management
Working knowledge of ERP and data base systems

Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Please note - this is a temporary (12 month) position located in Vancouver, BC only. Relocation is not supported for this temporary role.

EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games.

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate, and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

As a Data Analyst you will play a key role in analyzing our operational data to improve our Quality Verification strategies for the EA Sports titles (such as FC, NBA and NHL). You should be a sharp, curious, and analytic individual who has a passion for diving into data to solve business problems. Your insights will influence how we build and verify the quality of our games, and how to improve our business processes through data insights.

The Data Analyst will be responsible for assembling data from multiple sources, conducting analyses, performing research, interacting with different internal customers, designing, documenting, and implementing analytical solutions, as well as compiling and presenting results, in graphical and written summaries, to a variety of audiences. You will be responsible for building metrics reporting systems and for tracking process improvements across the organization. You will excel in a fast paced environment, managing multiple responsibilities and deadlines in an internationally based team. The ideal candidate would be an effective communicator who combines solid technical skills with pride in excellence, who also demonstrates the potential to grow into a client-facing consulting role and/or an analytical consulting role (i.e. development of simulation models).

What a Data Analyst Does At EA


Assembles data from multiple sources, conducts analyses, performs research, designs, documents and implements analytical solutions.
Presents analysis conclusions to the internal customer in a clear, understandable, and valuable way.
Communicates with team members and business stakeholders.
Presents high quality reports and findings in Power BI or as presentations.
Builds metrics reporting systems and tracks process improvements across the team.
Conducts analysis using statistical software, databases, spreadsheets, and reporting tools
Designs, evaluate and monitor key metrics, understanding root causes of changes in metrics
Develops and maintains scripts and queries to import, manipulate, clean, transform data from different sources
Builds and shares live dashboards and reports complete with user documentation
Builds and trains statistical models for hypothesis testing
Performs quality assurance on generated results to ensure accuracy and consistency
Presents conclusions in a clear and concise way


The Next Great Data Analyst Needs


Relevant experience in a past analytical role.
Expert data visualization techniques for charts and reports - good knowledge of Microsoft Power BI and/or Tableau.
Unstructured Data handling - Know best practices on how to stage unstructured data and properly model it to solve the problem at hand
Must have very good database and SQL knowledge, NoSQL and elastic search - a strong bonus.
Data Analysis - good knowledge of R language, MS Excel mastery, including VBA, PivotTables, and array functions - or other similar tools used for discovering data patterns and correlations through statistical methods.
Good math and analytical skills including statistics, simulation, and optimization.

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Marketing Team in Vancouver, Calgary, or Toronto.

What your team does:

The Monetization team leads Clio’s AI-first pricing and packaging strategy and execution across all regions, including initiatives for new and existing customer segments, products, plans, bundles and cross-portfolio upgrades. This is a highly strategic team contributing to Clio’s success in a highly cross functional role working across nearly all functions at Clio.

Who you are:

You're analytical and curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working through large volumes of data to find the story in the numbers. You like turning ad hoc, manual processes into something repeatable, and you enjoy building partnerships across the business. You're also detail-oriented, organized, and self-managing, with a habit of verifying your own work. You build in checks, flag what looks off, and hold a high bar for accuracy.

What you’ll work on:

As a Pricing Analyst, you'll own the execution and measurement of pricing changes, from account migrations in our billing systems and Salesforce to the modeling, reporting, and testing that tell us whether a change worked.


Own recurring price-based account migrations end to end, from cohort segmentation and batch processing through QA and post-migration validation, and build the formula-driven templates that make them repeatable and auditable at scale
Support the models that price new releases and size the impact of changes on existing customers, and help package the findings into recommendations
Partner with Data & Insights to build the dashboards and automated reporting that track realized vs. list price, discount depth, and ARPA by cohort, so the team catches problems early
Work across Billing Ops, Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Enablement to automate the manual steps in pricing execution and equip Sales and CS when prices change
Help design and run in-market price tests to validate willingness to pay before changes roll out broadly
Use AI tooling to compress the analysis and execution cycle, from generating and QA'ing migration cohorts to automating the handoff into Salesforce and building intuitive internal pricing calculators and price sheets


What you may have:


2+ years in financial or business analysis and modeling, preferably for B2B SaaS, including heavy spreadsheet work with nested logic and QA across large datasets
Hands-on experience in a subscription billing system (Zuora, Stripe, Chargebee, or similar) and a CRM like Salesforce, including bulk updates and data validation across large account sets
2+ years building dashboards and queries in Looker, Tableau, or similar
Experience with pricing analysis across SaaS charge models, such as subscription, usage-based, tiered, and per-seat
Experience running cross-functional projects in Asana or similar, coordinating with ops and GTM teams to keep work moving
Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver clear status updates, business insights, and recommendations in written, presentation, and spoken form
Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to support analysis, workflows, and day-to-day productivity


Serious bonus points if you have:


Experience with Workato or similar integration and task-automation tools
Prior experience executing pricing or plan migrations at scale


This role is a backfill for an existing position.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:


Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Role Summary

The McAfee Strategic Analytics team, part of the Analytics & Data Science organization, is expanding its capabilities to strengthen data-driven decision-making across a global direct-to-consumer business serving over 400 million customers. Our team is tasked with leading interesting analytics projects crossing business silos and partnering with technical experts to drive measurable outcomes.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a product-owner mindset who will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between raw telemetry and strategic business action. You wont just pull data; you will own the narrative, building scalable solutions in Databricks and uncovering root causes that drive marketing performance and product health. You will get credit for your work and exposure to McAfee's highest levels of leadership.

This is a hybrid role based in the Waterloo, Canada. You will be required to be onsite on an as-needed basis; when not working onsite, you will work remotely from your home location.

Position Details

About The Role


Drive Strategic Analytics: Move beyond descriptive reporting to diagnostic and predictive analysis. You will proactively identify business variances (e.g., retention drops, funnel leakage), isolate root causes (mix shift vs. performance), and recommend actionable solutions to leadership.
Own End-to-End Execution: Act with high agency to take projects from vague problem statements to deployed solutions. You will serve as the analytics lead for your domain, managing stakeholders, defining requirements, and driving progress with minimal supervision.
Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and build robust data pipelines and sandboxes within Databricks (PySpark/SQL) that serve as the "Single Source of Truth" for the organization. You will optimize code for performance and reliability.
Communicate with Impact: Serve as a "technical translator" who can synthesize complex data findings into clear, executive-level narratives. You will present insights in high-stakes forums to drive consensus and alignment.
Foster Data Excellence: Champion best practices in data governance, definitions, documentation, and ensuring that the business trusts the numbers you produce.
We are looking for someone curious about data, passionate about building analytical solutions, and eager to become a trusted data expert who empowers others through insight and clarity.


About You


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline with 2+ years of experience.
Demonstrated proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience performing data exploration, transformation, and analysis across large-scale relational and analytical datasets.
Strong understanding of data architecture principles, including logical and physical data modeling, data structure design, and data integration best practices.
Demonstrated ability to ensure data integrity and consistency across multiple data sources, and to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable, and well-structured data solutions.
Solid background in statistical analysis and experimentation, including hypothesis testing methodologies (Frequentist, Bayesian, or multivariate A/B testing).
Familiarity with data governance practices, metadata management, and documentation standards to support transparency, consistency, and operational excellence.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse technical and non-technical audiences.


LI-Hybrid

Company Overview

McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.

Company Benefits And Perks

We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.

We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family-friendly benefits to all of our employees.


Bonus Program
Pension and Retirement Plans
Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
Paid Time Off
Paid Parental Leave
Support for Community Involvement


We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

Pay Range

The anticipated compensation for this position is CAD $85,580.00/Yr. - CAD $115,780.00/Yr. depending on experience and qualifications.

Title: Data Analyst - Digital Marketing
Description:
What The Role Does

Transform search engine marketing data into smarter campaigns and high-performing digital marketing strategies.

As a Data Analyst - Digital Marketing, you will combine strong analytical skills with hands-on ownership of a large-scale search engine marketing portfolio. You will use campaign performance data, financial results, internal reporting, and AI-enabled tools to uncover opportunities and improve campaign profitability, quality, efficiency, and return on investment. You will also apply creative skills to develop clear, customer-focused advertising that helps more people around the world access modern legal solutions.

This is a full-time, permanent position working 37.5 hours per week, with the option to work hybrid from our Edmonton, Alberta office.

What You’ll Do


Plan, implement, and manage a portfolio of paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising to increase website traffic and drive conversions.
Analyze campaign performance data, financial results, and key performance indicators to uncover actionable campaign change tactics
Optimize and adjust campaign bids to maximize profitability and ensure peak performance
Review campaign structures, budgets, targeting, and other performance levers to improve efficiency and maximize profitability.
Utilize internal reports and AI tools to accelerate data-driven decisions that enhance campaign effectiveness
Monitor data quality and campaign health, investigate variances, and implement solutions that support accurate reporting and dependable campaign management.
Conduct keyword, search query, competitor, and market research to identify campaign optimization and growth opportunities.
Build product level knowledge to evaluate advertising opportunities and tailor campaign strategies to customer needs.
Review user level information to develop relevant audience segments and targeting strategies.
Support creative work by writing compelling advertising copy, crafting brand messaging, contributing to landing-page updates, and coordinating image and video assets within the advertising platforms.
Research paid search platforms, AI capabilities, new advertising formats, and industry developments to identify valuable new approaches and stay up to date on best practices.
Communicate complex analysis and recommendations clearly to support informed decision-making.
Collaborate with cross functional Legal, Product, and Development teams to execute projects.


What You Bring

The Essentials


Post-secondary education in Business, Marketing, Finance, Management Information Systems, Operations Management, Data Science, Economics, Computing Science, or another analysis-related program.
Experience analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience with complex formulas, PivotTables, data visualizations, and data analysis.
Excellent time management skills and the ability to balance multiple projects.
Experience using AI tools to support analysis, reporting, writing, research, and productivity.
Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to develop concise, persuasive advertising copy and conversion-focused messaging.
Sound judgement and strong data-driven decision-making ability.
Ability to communicate findings clearly, synthesize complex analysis, and make actionable recommendations.
Natural curiosity and a strong problem-solving mindset, with a track record of fast learning and adapting to new platforms or methodologies.
A collaborative working style and the ability to contribute effectively across team projects.


The Nice to Haves (Great if you have it and we’ll help you learn if you don’t)


Knowledge of PPC / SEM campaign management (Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising) and marketing KPIs.
Proficiency with Power BI for data visualization and business intelligence.
Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, Canva, or other digital creative tools.
Experience with Google Analytics, or other marketing analytics tools.
Ability to learn Content Management System tools to update website content.
Experience with Python, VBA, R, Task Scheduler, or related analytical and automation tools.


Why You Should Join The LawDepot Team


Excellent total compensation package
Comprehensive health and dental benefits, plus an additional Health Care Spending / Personal Spending Account
Great work life balance (37.5 hour work weeks, flexible schedules, ability to bank hours)
Three weeks paid vacation, plus bonus personal days
Continuous learning opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and training budgets
Company share plan
Free catered lunches for the entire office
Monthly social events for team members to enjoy (think axe throwing, rock climbing, board games, food trucks, trivia contests, and charitable activities)
Work alongside talented, driven colleagues in a culture focused on quality, reliability, innovation, and growth
Personal offices for focused work and to have your individual space (plus collaborative workspaces for when you want to meet with the team)
Free and easily accessible parking
Southgate Mall, Whyte Ave, and Calgary Trail restaurants are only minutes away
Hybrid working arrangements for that balance between getting work done at home and engaging with others in the office


Who We Are

Join one of the fastest growing companies in Canada! LawDepot is proud to be a seven-time Growth 500 ranked organization and a major player in the Global legal solutions industry. Our mission is to modernize the legal document creation experience by empowering people with fast, easy-to-use, and professional solutions. At LawDepot, we foster a collaborative and inclusive learning culture that values excellence. Apply today and become a part of our exciting journey!

Title: Business & Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

The Commerce Systems team within Hexagon's Autonomous Solutions division is looking for a Business & Data Analyst to join our high-tech engineering and manufacturing company that is committed to customer service excellence and continuous improvement. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a dynamic, fast-paced, highly collaborative team in driving tangible and measurable results. Reporting to Senior Manager, Commerce Operations in the Commerce Systems team, you will interact with key business teams (primarily sales and marketing) while supporting, improving, and extending our commerce system capabilities across our autonomy and positioning portfolio.

The Location: Hexagon is a global company with locations around the world. This position is based onsite in Calgary, AB and we offer hybrid work once both training and onboarding are completed.

Responsibilities

As a Business & Data Analyst, responsibilities include:


Business Analysis
Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements.
Translate requirements into clear, testable system requirements.
Act as the liaison between business and technical teams.
Manage requirements throughout their lifecycle, including updates and change tracking.
Partner with other Business Analysts to support KPI tracking and measure solution success.
Support UAT and validation to ensure delivered solutions meet business needs.
Data Analysis
Use SQL and other data analysis techniques to query databases, investigate data issues, validate business processes, identify trends, and support decision-making.
Develop and execute complex SQL queries to support requirements analysis, testing, root cause investigation, and reporting activities.
Support our Business Intelligence and data analytics competency and capabilities.
Design and develop reports fit for the purpose of business requirements.
Change Management
Lead stakeholder readiness and adoption for system changes.
Develop training materials and support enablement.
Act as a primary support contact during change rollouts and post-release stabilization.
Process Improvement and Documentation
Maintain requirements, process, and training documentation.
Identify and recommend process improvements.
Ensure documentation is accurate, current, and aligned with system changes.

Qualifications

Must-Have:


Bachelor’s degree in business with supporting IS/technical project experience.
A minimum of 5 years’ business analysis or a related field.
Strong SQL proficiency with the ability to develop complex queries, join and analyze data across multiple tables, troubleshoot data issues, validate results, and support reporting and analytics initiatives.
Demonstrated experience in requirements elicitation and translation into effective stakeholder and system level requirements.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Experience working with cross-functional teams to design and implement processes, workflow, and administrative optimizations, including demonstrated ability to work with remote/offshore teams.
Owns the outcome by taking personal accountability for delivering strong results.


Key Success Factors:


Thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
Takes ownership of outcomes and proactively identifies solutions.
Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and driving clarity for stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail, particularly around data quality and documentation.
Demonstrates curiosity and analytical thinking by leveraging data to identify root causes, validate assumptions, and recommend solutions.


Nice-to-Have:


Previous Salesforce or ERP experience.
Previous experience supporting Jira and Agile delivery teams.
Certified Business Analyst Professional (CBAP) or related Business Analyst certification.

Our work touches every aspect of life, from sustainability on Earth to enabling autonomy. Creation, maintenance, and updating of PowerBI reports to support Mine department decision making
Support routine reporting processes across a variety of areas including production, maintenance, and safety

Engage with underground frontline workers and supervisors in the mine to identify and support improvement opportunities

Liaise and coordinate with internal and external clients to provide data management solutions
Work on a wide variety of environmental projects at a time, on sites located locally, across North America, and internationally
Manage and organize laboratory, field, spatial and geological data to ensure quality and consistency
Maintain and query data using EQuIS, MS Access and MS SQL Server
Produce data reports using in-house software and/or specialized queries
Assist in developing standards and procedures for data management process improvements
Actively communicate and coordinate with project managers, laboratories, and/or other team members to acquire data packages of varying formats to be imported to a centralized database system

Familiarity with EarthSoft EQuIS and/or MS Access and/or SQL Server, with a strong understanding of database relationships

Exceptional attention to detail
Passion for working with data and have had exposure to environmental analytical data
Strong problem-solving skills
Capable of working both independently and in a team environment
Ability to adapt to a changing environment and handle multiple priorities, with ability to self-manage priorities, deadlines and budgets
Dedication to meet project deadlines in a timely manner
Excellent verbal communication with peers, project managers and clients

Education and Experience


2+ years of related data management experience in the environmental or analytical chemistry sector
B.A. or B.Sc. in Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Chemistry, Geography or related field, or a certificate/diploma in Database Management, Environmental Science, Environmental Studies, Geography, or related field.

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is looking to hire a permanent, full-time Procurement Data Specialist in Edmonton or Calgary who will report to the Procurement Performance Manager.

The Procurement Data Specialist will be an expert and owner of all procurement master data. Responsibilities include collaborating with internal stakeholders, external suppliers and Caterpillar to gather and process information requirements to facilitate the daily and long term requirements vital to the ERP system and identify value-added opportunities across the organization. This role will also be responsible for analyzing and evaluating data for accuracy, updating master data as well as troubleshooting and resolving problems related to procurement master data. Another key responsibility will be creating reports/dashboards to support the procurement department and drive continuous improvement to achieve procurement excellence.

Major Job Responsibilities:


Manage and optimize procurement data and systems by maintaining the integrity of supplier, item, and related master data within the enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, while supporting overall system functionality and data architecture.
Partner with internal and external stakeholders to gather business requirements, support data analysis, and translate operational needs into system and process improvements that enhance procurement performance.
Support ERP systems and continuous improvement initiatives by contributing to system enhancements, configuration changes, and integration activities in collaboration with IT and cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
Develop and maintain data governance standards by establishing data policies, controls, and best practices to ensure consistency, accuracy, compliance, and system integrity across procurement processes.
Design and deliver reporting and insights by developing and maintaining reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs to support decision-making, performance tracking, and operational visibility.
Provide mentorship and guidance to Procurement Data Coordinators and support cross-functional teams in data processes, reporting tools, and system usage.
Lead and contribute to continuous improvement efforts by identifying opportunities to optimize procurement systems, workflows, and data processes, and ensuring initiatives are tracked through to completion.


Education and Experience:


Post-secondary degree in Business or Supply Chain, related to Data Management, Operations Management or related field
2+ years experience in a Data Management or Supply Chain role
Strong computer skills and proficient in MS Office Suite – specifically Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
Experience with MS Power Automate or similar workflow automation tools
Experience with analytics and the development of reports, metrics and dashboards using tools such as PowerBI
SQL and Excel (VBA) knowledge is an asset
Previous experience with SAP Ariba would be an asset
Knowledge and understanding of end-to-end supply chain management
Working knowledge of ERP and data base systems


Soft Skills:


Highly developed analytical and problem solving skills
Quality and timeliness - demonstrates a high level of organization, accuracy, and thoroughness, monitors own work to ensure quality, and able to prioritize key tasks versus required timelines.
Takes initiative and displays creativity and innovation in achieving results
Clear concise written, verbal, communication, presentation skills that are professional, timely and accurate
Strong customer focus
Ability to influence and collaborate
Ability to adapt to changing requirements and provide necessary support
Passion for driving continuous improvements

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process such as reviewing applications. These tools assist the recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

FacilityOS thanks all candidates for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

Compensation Range: CA$85K - CA$95K

Identify areas or opportunities within the business for operational efficiencies and/or revenue growth, analyzing and implementing changes that will influence store operations strategy and drive improved profitability.

Collaborate with many teams to unlock new analytics that drive common objectives.

Professional accounting designation (CPA, CA, CGA, CMA) and/or master’s degree in MMA, MBA, or analytics is considered an asset.

Ability to manage multiple projects, driving key business results under tight deadlines.
Strong problem solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills; able to see the “big picture” in a complex business environment.

Working knowledge of Python, SQL or other coding languages and experience with Azure Synapse and/or Databricks.

Title: Data and Analytics Lead
Description:
Job Description

Midland Transport is currently seeking a Data and Analytics Lead in Dieppe, NB. The Data and Analytics Lead is a transformation role within the Pursuit Program, accountable for serving as the primary data and analytical lead for the Maintenance domain. This role provides deep expertise in how data moves across the business—how it is created, consumed, transformed, and connected—to support integration design, operational insight development, and evidence-based decision-making throughout the transformation lifecycle.

The Data and Analytics Lead bridges the gap between business operations and data architecture by mapping current-state data flows, identifying data quality gaps, and defining future-state data requirements that align with integration strategies and platform modernization objectives. They translate complex data relationships into clear, actionable insights that inform product design, process optimization, and business case development.

This role partners closely with Business Architects, Solution Architects, Integration Leads, Product Owners, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data integrity, analytical rigor, and alignment between domain-specific data needs and enterprise-wide data strategy—enabling confident, data-driven decisions across the transformation.

Benefits To Joining Midland:


A dynamic, safe, and rewarding work environment
A flexible health, drug, dental, and vision plan
RRSP matching program
Employee & Family Assistance Programs
Health & Wellness reimbursements, includes gym memberships, fitness classes or online workout programs
3 weeks' paid vacation
Maternity leave top-up program
Growth and progression opportunities within Midland Transport and large network of the JD Irving group of companies


Responsibilities


Act as the data and analytics lead for Maintenance, building deep understanding of data across systems and processes.
Document and align data flows with transformation goals.
Deliver insights and reporting that support decisions, process design, and business cases.
Analyze current and future data flows to identify gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.
Collaborate with architects and integration leads to ensure accurate data requirements in solution design.
Define and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and exception handling.
Support data governance, including cataloging, metadata, and master data consistency.


Qualifications


5-8 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or data engineering within operational or transformational environments.
Applicable degree or relevant experience
Proven experience mapping data flows and multi-system environments.
Demonstrated ability to translate operational data into actionable business insights for senior stakeholders.
Experience working with Agile, hybrid, or phased delivery models in enterprise programs.
Deep understanding of data architecture concepts, data flow mapping, and integration patterns.
Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and analytical platforms.
Proficient in SQL, data modelling, and data quality management practices.
Ability to work effectively across business and technical teams, translating between operational language and data/system terminology.
Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting data-driven findings and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
Data Analytics certification (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate) considered an asset.


About Us

Founded in 1882, J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) operates in Eastern Canada (New-Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Québec, Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador), as well as in USA. We are a team of 20,000 dedicated employees. At J.D. Irving, Limited, you are part of a dynamic team of professionals who lead with integrity and are passionate about delivering results. With a culture that nurtures talent and creates an inclusive workplace, you can grow your career across our various operating divisions.

At Midland, we’re not just moving freight — we’re building the next generation of transportation. We’ve been one of the most trusted carriers in Canada and the United States for over 55 years. We are driven by superior quality service, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

Title: Specialist, Reporting
Description:
Job Description

The Opportunity

The successful candidate will be responsible for turning data into meaningful insights and reporting. The key will be understanding the claims data and report the trends using visualization tools. This opportunity will place you at the forefront of leveraging data visualization tools and strategize the transformation of data into insights within Definity Claims Team.

What To Expect


Discover opportunities to transform reports into dashboards to deliver more actionable insights and continuously improve the claims analytics environment
Gather reporting or dashboarding requirements from stakeholders; steer meetings with data management team to understand data and facilitate meetings with business stakeholders to accurately assess the analytical need for building reports/dashboards
Be passionate and creative in designing analytical wireframes and developing dashboards
Recommend effective visual analytical solutions which drive an analytical mindset within the organization
Conduct preliminary analyses on data involving basic statistical approaches and provides solutions to treat various data inconsistencies to support reporting integrity
Organize data for use by other analyst roles and business users within Claims
Support the business by developing and providing training and documentation on dashboards


What You Bring


University or college degree in data analytics, big data analytics, business analysis or similar field, preferably masters or equivalent experience
2-5 years of experience of using Tableau to create dashboards and develop value-creating business insights from operational performance indicators and scorecards
Experience using SQL for data manipulation, aggregation and generation of meaningful insights
Experience with BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform for analytics is a strong asset
Experience in the P&C Insurance industry is a strong asset
Experience with agile methodology for analytics development; experience with JIRA & Confluence an asset
Excellent communication and organizational skills; comfortable with ambiguity and ability to work independently with minimal supervision


Salary Range: $73,500 - $123,500

High degree of proficiency with English required to service customers, both internal to the company and external, across Canada.

About Us

Actual salary for the role may vary depending on work location of the successful candidate and other factors including but not limited to, skills, education, experience, working conditions and the local labour market.

This position is being posted to fill an existing vacancy.

Interested in this role, but don’t meet every requirement? We encourage you to apply! We know from experience that a candidate doesn’t need 100% of the qualifications listed to bring incredible value to our team. We’re actively seeking diverse backgrounds and perspectives to help us make insurance better. At Definity, inclusion, diversity, and equity aren’t just “nice to have” — they’re essential to our success.

What’s in it for you?


Hybrid work schedule for most roles
Company share ownership program
Incentive Program - Eligible employees may participate in various incentive plans which are paid out at the discretion of the company and subject to individual and company performance.
Pension and savings programs, with company-matched RRSP contributions
Paid volunteer days and company matching on charitable donations
Educational resources, tuition assistance, and paid time off to study for exams
Focus on inclusion with employee groups, support for gender affirmation surgery, access to BIPOC counsellors, access to programs for working parents
Wellness and recognition programs
Discounts on products and services


Go ahead and expect a lot — you deserve it.

It’s better here — but don’t take our word for it. Definity was named by Great Place to Work® as one of the Best Workplaces™ in Canada for women, for youth, and for inclusion.

Our inclusive work environment welcomes diversity and supports accessibility. If you require accommodation at any time during the recruitment process, please let us know by contacting accessibility@economical.com.

As part of Definity’s commitment to reconciliation, we acknowledge that our work, meetings, and travel take place on the lands now known as Canada, and recognize the enduring presence, wisdom, and stewardship of the First Nations, Métis, and Inuit peoples who have long cared for these lands.

Background checks

This role requires successful clearance of background checks (including criminal checks and leadership references).

Definity is the parent company to some of Canada’s most long-standing and innovative insurance brands, including Economical Insurance, Sonnet Insurance, Family Insurance Solutions, and Petline Insurance. Our ambition is to be one of Canada’s leading and most innovative property and casualty insurers. We offer a flexible, hybrid work experience where employees work from the office and virtually depending on the type of work they are doing and who they are working with. Bring your true self and be a part of our journey. It’s better here.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Hi, we're HUB!

We are a leading North American insurance brokerage that advises businesses and individuals on how to reach their goals. When you partner with us, you're at the center of a vast network of risk, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management specialists that bring clarity to a changing world with tailored solutions and unrelenting advocacy – so you're ready for tomorrow.

The Opportunity!

This is a permanent, full-time position, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence at HUB Canada West (HCW).

As the Data Scientist, you are the technical engine of a small, high-leverage analytics function. This role exists to turn HCW's growing data foundation across cloud data platforms and SQL into measurable business value: predictive models, self-serve analytics, intelligent automation, and AI-powered tools that change how branches and leadership make decisions.

The successful candidate brings classical data science fundamentals (statistics, machine learning, experimental design) and is equally comfortable in the emerging world of AI engineering: prompting and orchestrating large language models, building reusable AI workflows, and integrating LLMs into BI products. As the discipline of data science continues to converge with AI engineering, we want someone who can move fluidly across both.

You will operate as a senior individual contributor and a generalist problem solver. You enjoy ambiguity, you pick up new tools quickly, and you care about outcomes more than orthodoxy.

What You'll Bring To Our Team -


5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, analytics engineering, advanced analytics, or a directly related applied technical role.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or similar). Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal credentials.
Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry is a strong asset, with practical familiarity with concepts such as policies in force, premium, retention, and producer compensation.
A generalist, problem-solving mindset: comfortable picking up new tools, languages, and platforms; energized by ambiguity rather than blocked by it.


Skills & Competencies

Must-Haves


Strong SQL skills, including comfort with complex joins, and query optimization against large datasets.
Strong Python skills for analysis, modelling, and automation (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), plus practical experience with ML Algorithms such as Random Forest, Recommender Systems or Clustering.
Demonstrated production experience with Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, and the ability to design dashboards that leadership can intuitively use.
Working knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, and model evaluation; able to choose the right tool for the question rather than reaching for the most complex one.
Demonstrated ability to use Claude (or other AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or equivalent) as a serious working tool: structured prompting, iterative refinement, awareness of failure modes, guardrails, and the discipline to verify outputs.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions and to write clearly for executive audiences.


Nice-to-Haves


Experience building Claude Skills, artifacts, MCP server integrations, or agentic AI workflows.
General familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery, is a plus as HCW's data environment evolves.
Experience with light data engineering tooling such as dbt, Airflow, or Cloud Composer.
Comfort with version control (Git), code review practices, and collaborative development workflows.
Familiarity with Canadian data privacy requirements (PIPEDA) and the practical realities of working with sensitive customer and HR data.


A Day in the Life -

Analytics And Modelling


Design and deliver applied analytics and machine learning solutions across sales, retention, finance, operations, and talent (for example, customer segmentation, churn and renewal probability, book of business analytics, producer performance modelling).
Translate ambiguous business questions from leadership into structured analytical problems, choose the right level of methodological rigour for the decision at hand, and communicate results in plain language.
Apply solid statistical thinking to model evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and the honest framing of data quality limitations.


AI Engineering


Build and maintain production-grade prompts, Claude Skills, and AI-assisted workflows that extend HCW's analytical reach (for example, manager-facing prompt playbooks for self-serve call analytics).
Integrate large language models with HCW data sources to enable natural-language analytics, automated narrative generation, and intelligent document processing.
Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and bring promising techniques into HCW thoughtfully, with appropriate guardrails.


Data Access And Transformation


Extract, join, and transform data from HCW's data warehouse, Power BI semantic layer, and other source systems to support analytical work. Note: this is not a heavy data engineering role. Platform, ingestion, and core pipeline work sits primarily with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT. The Data Scientist is expected to access and shape data, not to build the warehouse.
Engineer features, build reproducible analytical pipelines, and document data lineage and assumptions.


Business Intelligence And Self-Serve


Build interactive Power BI dashboards that make analytical output usable by branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives.
Develop reusable Power BI templates and data structures that let branch managers, regional leadership, and corporate executives self-serve their own analysis without relying on ad hoc analyst support.
Track adoption of Power BI reports and dashboards, and surface how they are being used to drive measurable business value across branches and leadership.


Automation


Identify high-friction manual reporting and operational workflows, then automate them using Python, scheduled data pipeline jobs, Power Automate, or AI-powered workflows.
Design automation that is observable, recoverable, and trusted by the business.


Stakeholder Engagement And Communication


Work directly with the COO, regional leadership, and operational managers to scope work and present findings.
Coach and uplift the broader BI community of practice on Python, SQL, AI tooling, and analytical thinking.
Collaborate with the Canada Data team and Corporate IT on data standards, governance, and shared platform decisions.


Salary Expectations -

The expected salary range for this position is $90,000.00 to $115,000.00 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope, and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages which could include extended health benefits, disability insurance, RRSP matching, paid-time-off benefits, and eligible bonuses. If you believe that your qualifications and experience surpass the minimum requirements for this role, we encourage you to submit your application. By doing so, we will be able to keep your application on file for consideration for potential future positions within our organization.

Why Join HUB?


Do you enjoy making friends? We love making friends; join our team of amazing people who all get along and thrive together!
We work hard and play hard! Get ready for our Staff Holiday Parties!!
Paid day off for your birthday – we want to celebrate you!
Paid day off for volunteering in your community – HUB is a company that gives back and is active in our communities.
Room to grow within the organization.
Lots of company perks, benefits, RRSP matching and great compensation.


Your Future with HUB -

Choose a career with HUB International and take the first step toward creating a future that combines a diverse, challenging work environment with financial security and career satisfaction. By joining HUB, you will become part of a rapidly growing company that offers significant opportunity for advancement.

At HUB, we value education and continuous learning, and we will assist you along your career development path. We provide HUB Ready training for new employees, as well as financial support for licensing, industry designations, management & leadership development, and other related courses, designations or programs.

What makes us different than all the rest?

Our Vision: To be everywhere risk exists – today and tomorrow. Helping protect what matters most.

Our Mission: To protect and support the aspirations of individuals, families and businesses. To empower our employees to learn, grow and make a difference in their communities.

Our Core Values


Entrepreneurship: We encourage innovation and educated risk-taking.
Integrity: We do the right thing every time.
Teamwork: We work together to maximize results.
Accountability: We measure and take responsibility for outcomes.
Service: We serve customers, communities and colleagues.


If you value what we value, and like the perks along the way – Apply TODAY!

The employment offer is contingent upon completion of a successful background check.

HUB is a company where your contributions will make a difference. We invite you to learn more about our team at www.hubinternational.com. If you require any accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out to hcw.hr@hubinternational.com to request this. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Department Business Operations

Required Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience

Required Travel: No Travel Required

We endeavor to make this website accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the recruiting team HUBRecruiting@hubinternational.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only; do not use this contact information to inquire about the status of applications.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At CI, we see a great place to work as one that is a safe place for everyone to have a voice, where people are empowered to take ownership over meaningful work, where there is an opportunity to grow through stretching themselves, where they can work on innovative products and projects, and where employees are supported and engaged in doing so.




We are seeking experienced Data Analysts to support a large-scale data migration and integration initiative. You will be responsible for investigating existing data structures, analyzing business logic hidden in queries and reports, mapping source data to target systems, and collaborating with business stakeholders to ensure accuracy and completeness.




This role is highly investigative and requires a blend of technical analysis and business communication skills. You should be comfortable navigating undocumented environments, reverse-engineering logic, and documenting findings clearly for both technical and business audiences.




This role follows our in‑office work model and requires employees to be onsite four days per week to support collaboration and business needs.




Key Responsibilities




Source System Analysis

Investigate source systems and databases to understand data structures, relationships, and logic.
Analyze existing SQL queries, reports, and stored procedures to reverse engineer business rules.

Data Mapping & Transformation

Map source fields to target model requirements.
Identify gaps, data quality issues, and transformation needs.
Work closely with data engineers to validate ETL/transformation rules.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with business SMEs and stakeholders to clarify definitions, logic, and requirements.
Translate technical findings into clear documentation for non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer

Produce detailed data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Capture undocumented business logic and processes uncovered during investigation.

Validation & Testing Support

Support data validation and reconciliation efforts during development and UAT.
Assist in resolving discrepancies between source and target systems.




Required Skills & Experience




Strong SQL skills, with ability to read, analyze, and write complex queries.
Proven experience in data migration, data warehousing, or system integration projects.
5 years of Data Analyst experience with a strong background in analyzing large datasets.
Strong data profiling, mapping, and reconciliation skills.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities in ambiguous environments.
Strong communication skills to work with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
Experience creating data dictionaries, mapping documents, and gap analysis reports.
Experience with dashboard tools such as Sigma or equivalent
Experience with code repository systems – Bitbucket or Git




Nice to Have




Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data platforms.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and tools.
Exposure to financial services or other regulated industries

In addition, The Company offers a variety of benefits to eligible employees, including health insurance coverage, wellness programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education-related programs, paid holidays and vacation time, and many others. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the company.

Working knowledge of statistical analysis, cost-benefit analysis and related analytical techniques.

Description:
Made Better isn’t just a claim; it’s our Dare promise.




Dare has been a proudly Canadian, family-owned company since 1889. Throughout our long history, we’ve created some of the most loved brands in the country including Bear Paws cookies, REALFRUIT gummies, Breton crackers, Melba Toast and many more. For over 130 years we had been located in the Kitchener area since the family’s original store opened in 1892. We are head quartered in Cambridge Ontario and we’ve expanded our roots far beyond. With manufacturing plants in North America and over 1400 employees, Dare is part of the fabric of Canada.




At Dare our dedicated team works passionately to uphold our tradition of excellence, innovation and quality in every aspect of our operations. Our state-of-the-art facilities utilize advanced technology to ensure consistency and quality while meeting the evolving needs of our consumers and customers.




Salary Target- $75,000

Onsite




Position Overview

As a key member of the Operations team this person will be responsible to assess and report on the financials of the Cambridge facility. This position will be the go to resource for the Production & Maintenance teams ability to meet budget and help ensure financial stability of the plant.

Production and Operations Analysis

Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly operational performance reports.
Analyze production efficiencies, labour utilization, downtime, waste, and yield metrics.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
Support plant management with data-driven recommendations to improve productivity and reduce costs.
Track production results against budgets, forecasts, and operational targets.

Cost and Financial Analysis

Assist in monitoring and analyzing plant manufacturing costs.
Investigate variances related to labour, materials, waste, and overhead expenses.
Support monthly financial reporting and plant performance reviews.
Maintain and update cost analysis reports and operational dashboards.
Partner with Finance to support budgeting and forecasting activities.

Inventory and Reporting

Monitor inventory levels and investigate discrepancies.
Support cycle counts and physical inventory processes.
Analyze inventory transactions to ensure data accuracy.
Maintain reporting databases and ensure the integrity of production and inventory data.
Develop and automate reports to improve business insights and reporting efficiency.

Continuous Improvement

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence projects.
Identify opportunities for process improvements through analysis of operational data.
Support root cause analysis for operational issues and performance gaps.
Assist with the implementation and tracking of corrective actions.

Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with Production, Maintenance, Quality Assurance, Supply Chain, and Finance teams.
Provide analytical support for capital projects, productivity initiatives, and operational improvements.
Prepare presentations and reports for plant leadership meetings.
Support special projects and business initiatives as required.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Business, Finance, Accounting, Operations Management, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field.
2 to 5 years of experience in a manufacturing, operations analysis, business analysis, or financial analysis role.
Experience working in a manufacturing or food production environment is considered an asset.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis tools.
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Dayforce, JDE, or a similar platform is preferred.
Experience using Power BI or other reporting and visualization tools is an asset.
Excellent organizational and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment

The Document Control Analyst provides analytical oversight of engineering drawings and technical records for the Lloydminster Upgrader, ensuring compliance with document management standards, revision control, metadata requirements, and records governance.
