Description:
Permanent

Job title:
Senior SQL Data Analyst

Salary:
$90,000 - $95,000 + Bonus + Benefits

Role status:
Current opening

Our client:
A well-established Canadian professional services organization with a national presence and a strong reputation within its industry.

This is a highly visible role offering exposure to senior leadership and key business stakeholders across the organization. Our client is looking for a strong Senior SQL Data Analyst who can work with large, complex datasets, identify trends and business drivers, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insights for the business. This opportunity is ideal for someone who combines advanced SQL and analytical capability with polished communication skills, strong business acumen, and the confidence to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Principal tasks and responsibilities include:

Write complex SQL queries to extract, validate, analyze, and interpret large volumes of business and operational data.
Analyze revenue, pricing, productivity, profitability, utilization, and other key business performance metrics to support decision-making and performance improvement.
Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities in the data, and provide actionable recommendations to business leaders.
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc reporting packages, dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for senior leadership.
Translate raw data into meaningful business insights that can be clearly understood by both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
Partner closely with leadership, finance, operations, and other business groups to understand reporting needs and answer key business questions through data.
Support strategic analysis, business planning, and performance reviews by delivering data-driven insight and thoughtful commentary.
Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, management reporting tools, and automated reporting solutions.
Validate data integrity, troubleshoot reporting issues, and help improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of business data.
Support business intelligence, reporting automation, and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
Present findings, trends, and recommendations in a polished, concise, and business-friendly manner to senior stakeholders.
Participate in special projects and ad hoc analytical initiatives requiring a strong mix of technical skill, business judgment, and communication.

Qualifications and pre-requisites:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong academic background preferred. Candidates from well-regarded Canadian universities such as Western, Queen's, Laurier, Waterloo, McMaster, University of Toronto, Toronto Metropolitan, or other prominent Ontario / GTA schools would be of particular interest.
5+ years of progressive experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, commercial analytics, business insights, or a related analytical role.
Advanced SQL skills are a must. This role requires someone who can independently write complex queries, pull and manipulate large datasets, validate outputs, and use data to solve business problems.
Strong experience analyzing large datasets and turning complex information into clear, relevant, and actionable insights for the business.
Experience with Power BI, Excel, and other reporting / visualization tools. Exposure to VBA, Python, Tableau, or similar tools would be considered an asset.
Excellent communication skills are a must. This role requires someone who can confidently and clearly explain analysis, trends, and recommendations to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Must be able to bridge the gap between data and the business - not just run reports, but clearly speak to what the data means, why it matters, and what actions should be taken.
Strong presentation skills, executive presence, and the ability to simplify complex information into a clear and compelling message.
We would be especially interested in candidates who have demonstrated strong communication and presentation ability through debate teams, Toastmasters, case competitions, client-facing roles, or other environments that reflect strong verbal communication and presence.
Strong critical thinking, curiosity, and problem-solving ability, with the instinct to dig into root causes and connect data back to business performance.
Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a visible role with accountability to senior stakeholders.
Polished, professional, and credible communicator with a strong business partnering mindset.

Additional information or perks:

Hybrid work environment.
Highly visible role with regular exposure to senior leadership and key decision-makers.
Opportunity to influence business decisions through data, analysis, and strategic insight.
Blend of technical analytics, reporting, and stakeholder-facing business support.
Strong long-term career growth opportunity within a well-established Canadian organization.
Comprehensive benefits package.
Competitive bonus opportunity.
Collaborative and team-oriented culture.
Strong commitment to employee development and continuous learning.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst




Who We Are




Teranet is Canada’s leader in the delivery and transformation of statutory registry services with extensive expertise in land and commercial registries. We also market insightful property and data solutions, as well as practice management automation to thousands of customers in the real estate, financial services, government, utilities, and legal markets. Founded in 1991, Teranet operates the Electronic Registration System for the Province of Ontario and Teranet Manitoba is the service provider to the Province of Manitoba.




Connect. Grow. Thrive Together.




To learn more about who we are, visit our website: www.teranet.ca




About the Role




We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Commercial Solutions Product Management team, where data and analytics play a key role in shaping product strategy and client solutions. While part of Product Management, this is a hands-on data and analytics role focused on delivering high-quality analysis and data-driven solutions.




This role combines data analysis, business & product analysis, and client-focused solution delivery. You will work across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to understand problems, shape the right approach, and deliver actionable outputs. You will operate as a thought partner, helping define problems, clarify requirements, and translate them into effective data solutions, while owning delivery end-to-end.




A critical part of this role is protecting and strengthening our core data offerings. This includes ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistent quality, reliability, and continuous improvement. You will also contribute to revenue growth by supporting custom data solutions, enabling product initiatives, and providing analytical input into new data-driven offerings.




What You’ll Be Doing




This role focuses on analysis, data delivery, mentorship, and stakeholder collaboration across both ongoing operations and new initiatives. You will…

Analyze data to generate insights that support product, client, and business decisions
Translate business needs into analytical approaches (requirements, use cases, impacts)
Design and deliver data solutions (queries, datasets, reports - recurring and ad hoc)
Own outputs end-to-end, ensuring accuracy, quality, and usability
Maintain and improve recurring data deliverables, protecting core revenue streams
Partner with Product and Sales on custom data solutions, business cases, and new offerings
Support research and analysis that informs product strategy and market insights
Collaborate across Product, Sales, Technology, and clients to align on priorities and outcomes
Communicate insights clearly through presentations, dashboards, and reports
Improve and optimize workflows using modern tools, automation, and AI-assisted approaches
Provide ongoing guidance, mentorship, and quality oversight to junior team members, helping elevate team output and consistency




About You




You are an experienced analyst who brings together strong technical skills, sound business judgment, and clear communication.




Technical Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields (E.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering)
5+ years of experience in data, analytics, or business/data roles
Experience working with both business and technical stakeholders
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel is required.
Experience with visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience working with large datasets and data modelling
Familiarity with modern data platforms and tools
Experience using automation or AI-assisted tools to improve workflows, efficiency, and output quality
Understanding of real estate and mortgage lending data, land registration concepts, and property-related datasets is considered an asset.
Knowledge of GIS concepts and experience using spatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS is considered an asset.




Core Capabilities:

Strong analytical thinking across data, business, and product problems
Ability to break down problems, gather requirements, and assess impacts
Hands-on experience delivering end-to-end data solutions
Clear communication of insights and recommendations
Ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work independently
Strong problem-solving and critical thinking, with a solution-oriented mindset
Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and initiative in driving outcomes
A natural inclination to mentor and support others, taking responsibility for team quality and development without needing direction
Curiosity and willingness to explore and adopt new tools and approaches, including AI-assisted capabilities.




What Success Looks Like




You bring clarity and structure to complex problems
You ask the right questions and help refine requirements
You deliver high-quality, reliable outputs that are clear, accurate, and ready for use
You maintain momentum and alignment across stakeholders
You translate data into clear, actionable insights
You build trust with both internal teams and clients
You take ownership of recurring and ad hoc data deliverables, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement
You actively support and mentor junior team members, helping raise the quality and consistency of team outputs
You are proactive and self-directed, taking initiative to move work forward without needing close guidance or constant follow-up
You are comfortable taking ownership of problems and moving them forward, even when there isn’t a clearly defined path and the work involves ambiguity




Let’s Talk Pay




We believe in being upfront about pay and helping you make informed decisions about your career. The annual pay range for this role is $106,040 - $114,400 CAD, inclusive of base salary and target incentive pay. We understand that great talent comes in many forms, each with unique skills, experience, and potential. Your salary will be tailored to reflect the experience you bring and the impact you’re ready to have on this role.




At Teranet, we also know that compensation extends far beyond a pay cheque. Along with your cash compensation, we offer a comprehensive package which includes the following:




100% Employer Paid Health Benefit Plan
Employer Matching Retirement Savings Plan
Paid Vacation, Floater Days & Sick Leaves
Maternity, Parental and/or Adoption Leave Top-Up Programs
Corporate Discounts & GoodLife Group Rate Membership
Employee Assistance Program – for you and your loved ones!




Our Human Approach to Hiring




At Teranet, we use smart technology to make hiring faster and more efficient. Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools help us review applications and identify strong matches—but the real decisions? Those are made by our awesome people.




Every interaction you’ll have, and every decision we make, is led by humans. AI may support us, but it’s human connection that drives every hire.




At Teranet, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected, and supported. We are dedicated to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of our customers and the communities in which we live and serve. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.




Come As You Are. We Like You That Way!

Autodesk Education Experiences, or AEX, helps students, educators, and education institutions build the skills and experience needed for the future of design and make. This role focuses on delivering insights and decision support while collaborating with data and technology teams as needed. Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders to understand business goals, clarify analytical needs, and translate broad questions into focused analyses, metrics, and deliverables
Analyze customer behavior, product usage, engagement, retention, marketing performance, and operational outcomes
Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, visualization tools, and appropriate analytical methods to answer business questions
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and reusable analyses that support decision-making
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into clear, practical recommendations
Communicate insights through visualizations, written narratives, presentations, and discussions tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences
Use approved generative AI tools to support analysis, coding, documentation, automation, synthesis, and business communication while validating outputs for accuracy and appropriate data handling


Minimum Qualifications


3+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, customer analytics, marketing analytics, product analytics, or a related field
Bachelor’s degree, professional credential, or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative, analytical, business, or related discipline
Strong SQL skills and experience independently querying, combining, validating, and analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable platform
Experience using Python or another analytical programming or scripting language
Experience with a business intelligence or visualization platform such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a comparable tool
Experience partnering with business stakeholders to scope analytical work and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Demonstrated use of generative AI tools—such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Cortex AI, or comparable platforms—to improve analytical, coding, or communication workflows


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, Operations, customer lifecycle, or product teams
Experience in technology, SaaS, education, or another data-rich environment
Experience using analytical methods to understand customer behavior or business performance


The Ideal Candidate

You are curious, analytical, and comfortable working with both data and people. You can move from an unclear business question to a focused analysis, explain your reasoning, and communicate what the data means in practical terms.

You are hands-on with analytical tools and use AI as a standard part of getting work done. You understand that AI can improve speed and quality, while judgment, validation, and clear communication remain your responsibility.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.

We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our San Francisco or Toronto offices, and to translate complex healthcare and product data into clear, actionable insights that drive strategy and business impact. You are a fit if you thrive in ambiguous, cross-functional environments, own analytical deep work end to end, and enjoy influencing decisions through rigorous, well-communicated analysis.

What you’ll do:


Work cross-functionally with Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success to scope and implement trusted business metrics, proactively identify data integrity issues, and optimize operational workflows.
Translate complex datasets into clear insights with strategic recommendations that drive measurable actions and outcomes to inform business priorities.
Communicate analysis results and outcomes clearly and tailor messaging based on the audience.
Help build and evolve our analytical foundation, including event instrumentation, metric frameworks, and scalable self-serve analytics tools.
Mentor other analysts and raise the bar for data storytelling, analytical rigor, and stakeholder influence across the organization.


What we look for:


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
5+ years of experience using SQL or similar big data querying languages.
5+ years of experience with a programming language such as Python or R.
5+ years of experience with applied statistical techniques, such as inferential methods, causal methods, A/B testing, or statistical modeling techniques.
Strong experience working with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, including modeling and analyzing customer, pipeline, and revenue data.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex findings from data and models into compelling insights for technical and non-technical audiences.


Bonus (Nice to have):


Advanced degree in applied mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, economics or a related field.
Experience working with sales organizations and familiarity with funnel and pipeline processes.
Strong mentorship and leadership skills, with a track record of elevating scientific standards and developing junior talent across teams.


Benefits & Perks:

As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:


Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.
Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.
Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short-term and long-term disability.
10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province.
A home office stipend.
401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.
Paid parental leave.
A local in-person meet-up program.
Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto.


(Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees)

To ensure fairness and proper consideration, we do not accept resumes or expressions of interest via email or social media messages. If you’re interested in a role, please submit your application directly through our careers page.

Please note that EvenUp may use AI notetakers and other recording devices in the recruiting process. If you interview with us, with your consent, we may record your conversations and summarize them into notes for internal use. Recording is optional, and declining will not affect your candidacy.

EvenUp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About The Opportunity

Job Summary

Under the supervision of the Data Quality & Research Administration Analytics Manager and with support of senior level team members, the Senior Data Analyst will work closely with key stakeholders to identify and conduct data analysis projects that support the mission and goals of the University and Northeastern University Research Enterprise Services (NU-RES). The Senior Data Analyst will provide support to key projects through data collection, computational support, and data interpretation and reporting, and will ensure data accuracy and consistent reporting by designing and creating optimal processes and procedures to systematize the data reporting process. The incumbent will use advanced data modeling, predictive modeling, and analytical techniques to develop reports used in key data submissions to internal and external stakeholders. Possess a good sense of humor, ability to be calm under pressure, and effectively communicate with report requestors to ascertain requirements for reports that tell an accurate story.

This job may also be based in Boston. If you are based in the United States, please apply here

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant subject area (e.g., computer science, data science, mathematics, statistics, information technology, or related field); 3+ years of experience with querying databases, SQL, and Microsoft Excel; experience developing robust dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI; creating visuals using data visualization best practices.
Proficiency with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Cognos or Snowflake preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using analytical concepts and tools, including data modeling and predictive analytics.
Project management, time management, and communication skills necessary to execute responsibilities in a collaborative, academic setting.
Teamwork and collaboration in a professional setting.
Demonstrated curiosity, problem-solving skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills with ability to advise and clearly communicate ideas and results to non-technical audiences.
Strong ability to manage multiple assignments while working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Ability to maintain a positive attitude and work well independently, within a team environment, and with external users as well as a variety of internal audiences.
Experience working with university research administration data and systems preferred.
Experience documenting business procedures and processes preferred.
Understanding of, and experience in, using AI-enabled tools to provide appropriate levels of support to daily work.
Familiarity with electronic research administration (eRA) systems (e.g., Coeus, ePAWS, or similar eRA platforms) preferred.



Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

45% — Data Collection, Assessment, Interpretation, and Reporting

Collect relevant data (both internal and external) to be used by college constituents to support decision making and strategic direction, resource allocation, internal and external reporting, and other operational decisions. Success factors include the accuracy and relevance of the data, analysis, and the clarity and usefulness of final reports. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Manage data sourced from both legacy systems (e.g., Coeus) and current eRA platforms (e.g., ePAWS 2.0), ensuring continuity and accuracy across reporting environments.

25% — Data Visualization

Oversee the development and maintenance of key performance dashboards that show progress toward strategic and operational goals related to research. Work closely with Research Enterprise Services stakeholders to identify opportunities for additional dashboard requirements as needs evolve. Develop and iterate on self-service reports and dashboards with an eye towards automation and re-use. Tools include Tableau (including Tableau Prep and Tableau Server), Cognos, and other visualization platforms as applicable.

10% — System Support

Evaluate and test back-end changes to electronic research administration systems as they impact data quality and access, including connectivity with Tableau and the Cognos Data Warehouse environment. Monitor data quality in reports and adjust as needed. Support migration activities between legacy and current systems, including data validation and reconciliation tasks.

10% — Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to define areas for process improvement and work with stakeholders to design and build technical processes that improve efficiencies and address business issues and needs. Develop and maintain documentation of data pipelines, reporting logic, and source-of-truth definitions to support team continuity and institutional knowledge.

10% — Ad Hoc Duties

Perform ad hoc research and analysis to support special projects and strategic initiatives serving faculty and staff across Research Enterprise Services in meeting their reporting and analytical needs. May include supporting AI-assisted data extraction, research analytics benchmarking, and cross-institutional data collaborations.

Applicants must have current work authorization for the country in which they will be based. The University is unable to sponsor a visa or work permit for this position.

Position Type

Data Planning and Analysis

Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness & life, retirement- as well as commuting & transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information.

Title: Data Analyst, Revenue Operations
Description:
About FacilityOS

FacilityOS is a fast-growing company redefining how facilities operate—bringing safety, security, and daily operations into one unified platform used by organizations around the world.

As we continue to scale globally, we’re building a team of driven, curious people who want to make an impact. You’ll be part of a dynamic, collaborative culture where individuals are trusted to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and grow in their careers. Our team comes together in-office twice a week to connect, collaborate, and build momentum.

If you’re looking to do your best work alongside a great team in a high-growth environment, FacilityOS is the place to build your career.

About The Role

Revenue Operations at FacilityOS owns the data layer behind how we go to market and how we build that that layer out on Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, sourced primarily from Salesforce and our GTM stack.

We are hiring a Data Analyst to own the models and reporting that sit on top of it. This is not a dashboard-maintenance role. You will build the semantic models, write the transformation logic, and be the person the GTM leaders and CRO come to when a number doesn't reconcile.

The role suits someone who has spent two to four years doing real analytics work and wants ownership of a data platform rather than a queue of report requests.

What You'll Own


Semantic models and reporting. Build and maintain Power BI semantic models and reports covering pipeline, bookings, forecast accuracy, conversion, retention, and customer health. Own the definitions, not just the visuals.
Data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric. Build and maintain pipelines and notebooks bringing Salesforce and GTM system data into the lakehouse. Own transformation logic, refresh schedules, and data quality checks.
Analysis that changes decisions. Quarterly pipeline and coverage analysis, segmentation and territory work, win/loss and cohort analysis, and ad hoc investigation into why a metric moved. Bring a recommendation, not just a chart.
Data integrity across the GTM stack. Reconcile Salesforce against downstream systems, find and fix the breaks, and flag the process problems causing them.
Documentation. Metric definitions, model lineage, and runbooks that let someone else pick up your work.


Required

What we're looking for


2–4 years in an analytics, BI, or data analyst role, ideally supporting a B2B SaaS revenue or GTM function
Strong SQL — joins, window functions, CTEs, query tuning
Hands-on Power BI: data modelling, DAX, star schema design, performance optimization
Experience building or maintaining data pipelines in a cloud platform. Microsoft Fabric is what we run; Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery experience translates
Python for data work — transformation, API pulls, automation
Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model (objects, relationships, reporting quirks)
Able to take an ambiguous business question, decide what analysis actually answers it, and present the result to leaders without hand-holding


Nice to have


dbt or an equivalent transformation framework
Experience with Gainsight, Gong, SalesLoft, Clay, ZoomInfo, or HubSpot
Exposure to SaaS revenue metrics — ARR, NRR, pipeline coverage, CAC payback
Git and a habit of version-controlling analytical work


How We Work

You will often be the most technical person in most rooms you're in. That means explaining your work clearly, pushing back when a request is the wrong question, and being direct about what the data does and doesn't support.

Why work at FacilityOS?

We Work Hard And Play Hard And We Do Both With Passion And Respect For One Another. Our Company Promotes a Fast-paced, Fun, Friendly, And Highly Collaborative Work Environment That Provides

🩺Comprehensive health coverage

🏠A Hybrid work environment

💡Opportunity for advancement and growth

🍕 Catered Events, Snacks, Drinks – You won’t go Hungry!

🥳 Birthday and Life Celebrations

🎉 Two annual parties in a year

FacilityOS Commitment

We believe that a diverse team is the key to innovation and growth. We are an equal opportunity employer that value diversity at our company and encourage all candidates to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

FacilityOS will accommodate individuals with disabilities through each stage of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise us of any needs when your interview is booked, and we will do our best to meet your needs.

Please note that all candidates must be legally eligible to work in the location in which you applied.

Background and Reference Checks

Any offer of employment may be conditional upon full background checks including a criminal record check, a credit check and employment and educational verifications. A reference check will also be conducted.

All advancement and hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us or click here.

Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder relationship skills.

We are seeking a highly imaginative and motivated individual with a combination of analytic, programming and data visualization skills to enhance our business intelligence and analytics capabilities.

In this role, you will be tasked with using data to discover opportunities and solve business problems. You should have a passion for how data can be used to drive deep, meaningful insights that enhance the customer experience, grow our businesses, minimize risk, and engage our employees.

Position Responsibilities

  • Work with operational teams to develop analytic and business intelligence solutions
  • Create complex stored procedures to extract and transform data for use in data analysis and process automation
  • Become a Disability data subject matter expert
  • Visualize and present data for management using software tools such as Microsoft Power BI
  • Support ad-hoc requests for data & analysis from the business
  • Partner with the Advanced Analytics team of Data Scientists on various projects

What motivates you?

  • You obsess about customers, listen, engage and act for their benefit.
  • You think big, with curiosity to discover ways to use your agile approach and enable business outcomes.
  • You thrive in teams and enjoy getting things done together.
  • You take ownership and build solutions, focusing on what matters.
  • You do what is right, work with integrity and speak up.
  • You share your humanity, helping us build a diverse and inclusive work environment for everyone.

Required Qualifications

  • Expert database knowledge with the ability to create complex code to process and interpret large volumes of detailed data
  • Experience with visualization and BI tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau or QlikView
  • Advanced experience in SQL in using Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio 2016+
  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • A capacity for constant learning from both success and failure, remaining open to change and continuous improvement
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, ability to explain technical concepts to management
  • Demonstrated ability to work with both technical and non-technical resources
  • Expert knowledge of MS Office Suite
  • Very strong problem solving, decision making, multi-tasking, prioritization, and collaboration skills
  • Experience with Agile/Lean Six Sigma

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Python, Java, R, VBA, Visual Studio
  • Familiarity with predictive models and advanced analytics
  • Experience & Business knowledge in Financial Services and Group Benefits

When You Join Our Team

  • We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
  • We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
  • As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

About Manulife And John Hancock

Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html.

Manulife is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Manulife/John Hancock, we embrace our diversity. We strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. Title: Senior Associate, Data Analyst
Description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Senior Associate, Data Analyst

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We’re driven by what’s possible, leveraging the power of data and technology to empower innovative solutions, inspire one another to dream boldly, and take transformative ownership of decisions and outcomes that directly impact millions of Canadians. Every challenge is an opportunity to lead from the front, working together toward a shared vision that extends far beyond banking.

We balance high-performance with investment in your long-term success, ensuring you have the support you need to do your best work. Here, you’ll take full accountability for your path, upskilling through hands-on experience and mentorship, to turn your curiosity into a career built on your own terms.

Are you ready to redefine what’s next?

About The Team

Data is at the centre of everything we do at Capital One. Your role as a Data Analyst on the team will heavily leverage your deep expertise in SQL. You will be a creative data wrangler, comfortable with extracting, transforming and analyzing large, complex datasets to uncover new narratives. This requires more than just the ability to write complex, performant queries; you must also possess a thorough understanding of database structures, query optimization techniques and best practices for data governance. Ultimately, you will be a proactive collaborator, skilled at articulating complex ideas through data visualization tools like QuickSight, Tableau or Matplotlib and eagerly sharing your knowledge across diverse teams.

About The Role

In this role, you will serve as a vital partner to the business, influencing strategy and execution across key areas like fraud prevention, credit risk or marketing. This role requires a blend of advanced technical analysis skills and strong business acumen to tackle complex challenges and deliver groundbreaking solutions. You will be responsible for translating technical insights into clear, concise and actionable strategic recommendations. Success in this position involves working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to implement strategies and innovative solutions that enhance performance, mitigate risk and drive profitable growth.

Your Responsibilities:


Strategic Stakeholder Partnership & Business Recommendations:


Engage directly with senior stakeholders (e.g., line-of-business leads, product owners, risk management) to deeply understand business goals, challenges and decision needs. Partner with them to prioritize initiatives and refine strategies. Drive business strategy by proactively identifying, quantifying risks and translating complex analysis into compelling, concise recommendations that guide critical roadmap and decision-making processes.


Actionable Insight and Executive Storytelling:


Draw clear business conclusions and present comprehensive insights that explain "what happened," "why it happened," "what it means" and "what we recommend doing next" (including risk mitigation or growth levers). Design and deploy rich data visualizations and craft crisp, executive-ready narratives and dashboards to empower senior leadership to make high-stakes decisions efficiently.


End-to-End Data Analysis and Execution:


Lead the full data analysis lifecycle, translating complex business problems into defined specifications and final implemented solutions.


Data Preparation & Transformation:


Apply expert-level SQL skills to efficiently transform raw data into clean, accessible datasets for yourself and other analysts.


Governance, Reporting and Automation:


Build, automate and maintain critical business reporting and controls for processes and proactively identify and deliver process improvements for efficiency.

Basic Qualifications:


At least 2 years of professional experience with SQL (e.g., Snowflake, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, etc.).
Proficient in SQL for data extraction, wrangling and advanced analytics including Joins, Window Functions, CTEs, Aggregations and performance trending across large enterprise data environments.


Preferred Qualifications:


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a quantitative field such as Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
At least 1 year of professional experience using dbt (data build tool) for data transformation, modeling and maintaining a production-ready data warehouse.
At least 1 year of experience applying strong analytical and mathematical skills to solve complex business problems.
Effective stakeholder management experience with strong skills in communication, negotiation, strategic thinking, influence and technical abilities is highly desirable.
Proficient in data analysis within a cloud environment, including experience with open-source programming (e.g., Python), advanced SQL for large datasets (e.g. Snowflake), version control (e.g. Git/GitHub) and cloud services (e.g. AWS).
Experience with Linux or equivalent is preferred.


Working at Capital One.

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.


Take ownership of your own potential:


Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.


Find your rhythm:


We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.


Benefits built for your life:


We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

The expected annual salary range for this position is $112,240 to $128,100. This role is also eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

We embrace the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI as every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers, business interviewers, and recruitment professionals. Our teams are equipped with training that empowers them to use AI responsibly.

Capital One Canada is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants and will meet the needs of those requiring reasonable accommodations.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at ARCanada@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Clutch

Clutch is Canada's largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car-buying experience to drivers everywhere. Customers can browse hundreds of cars from the comfort of their home, get the right one delivered to their door, and enjoy peace of mind with our 10-Day Money-Back Guarantee… and that's just the beginning.

Named one of Canada's top growing Companies two years in a row and also awarded a spot on LinkedIn's Top Canadian Startups list, we're looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.

Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017. Clutch is backed by a number of world-class investors, including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90. To learn more, visit clutch.ca.

About The Role

At Clutch, we believe advances in AI are fundamentally changing how great products are built. Traditional handoffs between product, design, and engineering are giving way to smaller, faster teams where builders can take ideas from concept to production in days instead of months.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join our data team to help build out the analytics and data infrastructure behind one of our newer business lines. You'll start by strengthening the production dashboards and data onboarding that our stakeholders rely on every day, then move into designing new data models largely from the ground up, helping shape what additional data sources could sharpen our analysis.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ownership: you'll work directly with stakeholders across the business to understand what they need, shape the data models and pipelines that get them there, and communicate your findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. If you're energized by ambiguity, enjoy building something net new, and want to bring modern engineering practices (including AI-powered tooling) into your analytics workflow, you'll thrive at Clutch.

What You’ll Do


Build, maintain, and improve the production dashboards and onboarding data pipelines that our business stakeholders rely on.
Design and build out new data models largely from scratch, helping identify additional data sources that could strengthen our analysis.
Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Operations, and Finance to translate business questions into clear, trustworthy analysis and reporting.
Build reliable, well-tested, production-ready pipelines using tools like dbt, Airflow, and Snowflake.
Use AI tooling as part of your everyday workflow to accelerate analysis, pipeline development, and iteration.
Communicate findings, models, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Own your projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery.
Contribute to data documentation and governance practices as our data infrastructure matures.


What We’re Looking For

Must Haves


5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data analytics, or a closely related field (6–7 years is ideal).
Strong SQL expertise, with comfort working across large or complex datasets.
Hands-on experience with a BI tool, i.e., Tableau or Power BI.
A proven ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of owning and delivering projects end-to-end, ideally with some project management experience.
A collaborative, energetic communicator who works well within a close-knit team.


Nice to Have


Experience with consumer credit or lending analytics, ideally from a banking background.
Fintech or SaaS fintech experience is strongly preferred.
Experience integrating AI tools into your day-to-day workflow.
Python or another coding language.
Experience with dbt,Airflow, and Snowflake.


Why You’ll Love It At Clutch


Autonomy & ownership – opportunity to build your process and influence the company workforce and at every level.
Help shape the future of car buying and selling in Canada by leading a critical part of our customer experience.
You’ll have a broad and direct ownership over data analytics during a phase of rapid growth.
We are dedicated to attracting and retaining top talent with top-of-market compensation packages.
Above market health & dental benefits.


Employment Type


New, Permanent Full-Time
Hybrid, Downtown Toronto three days a week


Compensation & Benefits


Salary range: $100,000 - 125,000
Benefits: Comprehensive benefits plans include healthcare, dental care, vision care, prescriptions, life insurance and dependent coverage; start from day 1. (Applicable for Permanent Full-Time)
Pay decisions reflect objective criteria: skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities and working conditions.


Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About The Role




This role sits on our Digital team, where your internal title will be Specialist, Digital, working primarily in a data analytics capacity across client engagements.




As a Specialist, Digital focused on Data Analytics, you are an early-to-mid career data professional with a strong foundation in analysis and a desire to grow both your technical and consulting skill set. Leveraging your analytics background, you will support the delivery of digital products for our clients through analytics and reporting solutions that help organizations better understand their data and make informed decisions.




In addition to your analytics work, you will gain exposure to broader areas of digital consulting, including digital product development, digital transformation, and user experience (UX/CX). You are interested in understanding how data supports product decisions, customer experiences, and overall business strategy.




You will work closely with senior analysts, data scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, and business stakeholders across a variety of client engagements. With guidance and mentorship, you will contribute to analytics initiatives including dashboarding, exploratory analysis, KPI tracking, and data quality validation, while also building broader consulting skills across areas such as project management, user experience, and design thinking.




You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to continuously improve your analytical and consulting capabilities.




What You’ll Do




Support client and internal teams in understanding business questions and translating them into analytical requirements
Analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and insights under the guidance of senior team members
Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports to track key metrics and performance indicators
Assist in documenting metrics, definitions, and analytics processes
Collaborate with data engineers and other analysts to support data modeling and reporting layers
Communicate insights clearly through visualizations, summaries, and presentations
Proactively identify opportunities to improve reporting, data quality, and analytical workflows




Qualifications




Minimum 2+ years of experience in a data analyst, business intelligence, or analytics-focused role
Programming experience in Python, Bash scripting, R or related language
Working proficiency in SQL and experience querying cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery)
Experience with Business Intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
Foundational understanding of data modeling and analytics best practices
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and metrics
A/B testing and causal analysis
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
Clear written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional and consulting-style environments
Interest in learning about data governance, privacy, and security best practices




Perks and Benefits




Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits Package
Retirement Planning
Parental Leave Program
Flexible Working Hours
Work from Home Flexibility
Service Recognition Programs
Socials, Outings & Retreats
Culture of Learning & Development




Konrad is committed to maintaining a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status will receive consideration for employment. If you have any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please notify us so we can provide suitable accommodation.




The estimated compensation for this position is $75,000 to $100,000. This is an estimate and a compensation offer will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities and alignment with market data.




While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Description:

Role: Logistics Data Analyst

Reports to: Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics

Status: Full-Time, Regular

Division: Enercare Home and Commercial Services

Location: Markham (Birchmount)

Compensation: $69,136 - $110,618

Please note that the compensation range listed includes base salary and potential incentive pay. Incentives such as bonuses are not guaranteed and depend on individual performance and company results. Actual compensation within the range will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications.

About The Role

Reporting to the Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics, the Logistics Data Analyst plays a critical role in transforming warehouse, distribution, inventory, and service parts data into actionable insights that drive measurable operational improvements.

This role supports Enercare's supply chain strategy by developing dashboards, analyzing operational performance, improving inventory accuracy, and enabling data-driven decision-making across logistics, warehousing, and field service operations. The successful candidate brings strong analytical rigor, curiosity for operational processes, and the ability to convert complex datasets into meaningful recommendations that improve service levels, productivity, inventory management, and customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

Performance Management & Reporting


Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational dashboards and performance reporting related to inventory accuracy, replenishment effectiveness, Parts on Truck (POT%), technician productivity, and other key logistics KPIs.
Transform large and complex datasets into actionable insights and recommendations for operational leaders and stakeholders.


Inventory Accuracy & Control


Redesign and manage ABC, control-group, and random cycle count programs; conduct gap analysis; establish counting frequencies; and recommend SOP improvements to improve inventory accuracy and compliance.
Support root-cause investigations and corrective actions related to inventory variances, stock discrepancies, and transaction integrity.


Warehouse & Distribution Analytics


Analyze warehouse and distribution material flow (receiving → put-away → storage → picking → packing → shipping) to identify bottlenecks, reduce cycle times, and improve operational efficiency.
Monitor inventory movement, aged inventory, and replenishment performance and recommend actions to improve service levels and reduce working capital.


Parts & Field Service Analytics


Conduct truck stock and service parts analytics, including usage modeling, min/max optimization, seasonality reviews, replenishment cadence evaluation, and standard truck stock recommendations aligned to 80/20 principles.
Develop insights and recommendations that improve Parts on Truck (POT%), parts availability, technician productivity, and First-Time-Fix performance.


Continuous Improvement & Automation


Support continuous improvement, Lean, and 5S initiatives by translating KPI trends into practical operational improvements, standard work, and visual management solutions.
Monitor, validate, and maintain analytical tools, dashboards, and automated reports to ensure data integrity and usability.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data quality, and eliminate manual processes.


Ad Hoc Analysis & Business Support


Deliver high-quality, decision-grade analytics to support operations, procurement, supply planning, and cross-functional business initiatives.
Collaborate with operational leaders to identify performance gaps and develop actionable solutions.


Operational Flexibility


This role will evolve with the needs of the business. The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate flexibility and agility by taking on additional duties, special projects, and cross-functional responsibilities as assigned to support organizational objectives, operational priorities, and continuous improvement initiatives.


KPIs You Will Influence


Inventory Accuracy (%)
Cycle Count Compliance (%)
Variance Closure Time
Parts Replenishment Stability
Min/Max Adherence
Parts on Truck (POT%)
Technician Productivity
Inventory Availability and Fill Rate
Aged Inventory Reduction
Improvements correlated to First-Visit - Rate (FVR) through optimized truck stock and parts availability


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
4-7+ years of experience in warehouse, distribution, inventory, or supply chain analytics with a demonstrated history of improving operational KPIs.
Proficiency with ERP, WMS, and reporting systems; SAP experience is considered a strong asset.
Advanced Excel skills and experience using Power BI for dashboard development and data visualization.
Experience working with SQL, Power Query, or other data analysis and transformation tools is considered an asset.
Experience cleaning, transforming, validating, and analyzing large operational datasets.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to develop structured, pragmatic, and actionable analytical approaches.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of logistics operations, including inventory control, replenishment, receiving, warehousing, picking, shipping, and supplier performance management.
Familiarity with Lean principles, 5S, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Position Overview

Zynga Poker is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Here's How You'll Shape The Player Experience


Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product direction
Experimentation: Design statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impact
Business Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performance
Game Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem


Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do


Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.
Analyze player behaviour to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.
Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.
Design game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.
Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga Poker
Support the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature health
Play a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor models
Actively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.
Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.
Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which aims to significantly increase each analyst’s impact through the power of LLMs
Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.


What You Bring


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.
Minimum of 4 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics team
Demonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous data
Proficiency in Python and SQL.
Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning.
Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.
Strong ability in both written and oral communication.
Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.
Willingness to take ownership of challenges.
Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable terms
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus


Bonus Points


Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminology
Familiarity with social casino economies

Description:
About the Canadian Bankers Association

The Canadian Bankers Association is the voice of more than 60 domestic and foreign banks that help drive Canada’s economic growth and prosperity. The CBA advocates for public policies that contribute to a sound, thriving banking system to ensure Canadians can succeed in their financial goals. cba.ca.




Job title: Analyst, Benchmarking & Data Analytics

Division: Corporate Strategy & Operations

Location: Toronto

Reports to: Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance




Overview




Reporting to the Director, Data Strategy, Information Management & Governance, the Analyst is responsible for collecting, validating, and analyzing data related to the financial services industry to produce banking industry reports and benchmarking outputs. The role places a strong emphasis on interpreting industry data, identifying trends, and translating findings into meaningful insights that reflect banking sector activity and developments. The Analyst will actively engage with member banks to support accurate data submissions, clarify context, and ensure reporting remains representative of the industry. The Analyst is also expected to analyze data trends to support briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy-related materials. The role includes applying strong data governance and data quality practices, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata to support transparency and consistency across reporting. Familiarity with business intelligence and data platforms (such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent tools) is required to support report creation.




Description of Responsibilities




Serve as a primary resource for banking industry benchmarking reports and a secondary resource for supporting advocacy and industry-focused initiatives
Perform regular updates by working with member banks to collect, validate, and input data into banking industry databases and benchmarking reports, ensuring reporting is timely and accurate
Analyze, evaluate, validate, manipulate, and cross-reference data while applying formal data quality rules, controls, and reconciliation processes to ensure accuracy, consistency and completeness of industry reporting
Interpret financial services data to identify trends, patterns, and developments within the banking industry
Support the development of briefing notes, publications, and other advocacy‑related materials through data analysis and trend interpretation
Apply departmental procedures to ensure the confidentiality, integrity and consistency of the data collected
Co-ordinate and participate in meetings with member banks, as required, to address concerns relating to data quality
Assist with industry surveys, as required, including supporting development, data collection, and analysis of results
Provide research and analytical support to cross‑divisional teams, CBA staff, and member banks to support understanding of banking industry trends and current issues
Maintain and update data dictionaries, metadata definitions, and data catalog entries to ensure transparency, usability, and alignment across benchmarking datasets and industry report
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of data governance frameworks, including standards for data definitions, metadata management, quality controls, and documentation




Key Qualifications, Abilities and Skills




Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related analytical discipline, with 3–5 years of experience in data analytics and reporting, including hands-on use of BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Microsoft Fabric)
Experience applying data governance and data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, and maintaining clear documentation of data structures, definitions, and metadata
High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with a structured approach to data validation, documentation, and reporting consistency
Exceptional numeracy, quantitative, analytical and research skills including the ability to think critically and present concise and accurate information
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain data insights and work effectively with bank members and stakeholders
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders, as required
Experience in the financial services industry is preferred; related knowledge such as financial and accounting principles, completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC) and a working knowledge of French are considered beneficial

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates throughout the recruitment process.




To apply for this position, please send your resume and accommodation requests, if needed, to talentmanagement@cba.ca, quoting the job title that you are applying for.




We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at the CBA; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Position Summary...The Manager, Data Analyst supports the Canadian Technology Data Engineering team by delivering hands on analytics, reporting, and insights for priority initiatives. This role focuses on translating defined business needs into high quality analysis, dashboards, and repeatable datasets—while partnering closely with Data Engineering to ensure reliable data sourcing, quality, and security practices. (No direct people management.)

What You'll Do...

Hands-on analytics delivery


Translate business questions into analytic requirements, data pulls, and repeatable reporting outputs.
Perform exploratory analysis and produce clear, decision‑ready insights; present findings in business language.


Data sourcing and integration


Identify and evaluate data sources; support processes to acquire, join, and validate data from multiple sources.
Partner with Data Engineering to improve dataset usability, documentation, and accessibility for analytics consumption.
Collaborate with other teams to aid with building visuals that directly support business decisions and ongoing operational tracking.


Data quality and controls


Monitor data quality indicators; proactively identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate fixes with engineering partners.
Coordinate and support security measures to safeguard information.


Initiative execution


Support multiple initiatives by tracking deliverables, documenting assumptions/definitions, and ensuring outputs are reproducible.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in analytics/data work.
Strong experience in Retail (Brick & Mortar and eCommerce) and as a Data Analyst (7+ years)
Strong SQL experience and proficiency with at least one analytics/programming tool (e.g., Python/R).
Demonstrated ability to assess data quality, validate sources, and communicate limitations/assumptions.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience with GCP/BigQuery and/or cloud data ecosystems.
Familiarity with statistical techniques (hypothesis testing, inference) and experiment measurement.
Experience with Generative and Agentic AI


Core Competencies


Strong execution, attention to detail, and documentation
Practical problem solving and data validation discipline
Clear communication and stakeholder responsiveness
Builds reusable assets; continuous improvement mindset

Demonstrates engagement and commitment to the team, developing others through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; and recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively to achieve objectives; communicates with impact and listens attentively to a range of audiences; and demonstrates energy and positivity for own work.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by making a positive impact for associates, customers, and the world around us (e.g., creating a sense of belonging, eliminating waste, participating in local giving).

Serve Our Customers

Delivers results while putting the customer first and applying an omni-merchant mindset and acts with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Title: Data & Research Analyst
Company: Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario
Description:
The Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario (RCDSO) is a leader in health care regulation. As the governing body for more than 12,000 dentists in Ontario, our mission is to act in the public interest by putting patients first. We are committed to transparency, accessibility, openness, and fairness in all our work.

 

Bring your excellent analytical and research skills to our team as a Data & Research Analyst within our Office of the Registrar (OTR) department.

 

The OTR department ensures that the College meets its mandate of patient protection and putting patients first in all the work that we do. They set the College’s strategic priorities, and oversee our regulatory functions and compliance, as well as operations. OTR maintains various stakeholder relationships, including working with the College’s Council, committees, and government relations. 

 

You will leverage data collected by the College to generate meaningful insights that support operational excellence, regulatory effectiveness, and strategic decision-making. Working with both structured and unstructured data, you will conduct descriptive, exploratory, diagnostic, and predictive analyses, identify trends and emerging issues, and communicate findings through clear reports, visualizations, and presentations to diverse audiences.

 

You are a curious and analytical professional with a strong attention to detail and a passion for evidence-informed decision-making. You enjoy investigating complex questions, translating data into actionable insights, and collaborating with stakeholders to support organizational priorities and continuous improvement.

 

This role will require the successful candidate to work remotely, with the capacity to attend mandatory in-person meetings as required. Requests to work in-office will be accommodated.

 

At this time, we are only considering candidates located in Ontario or who are willing to relocate and who are authorized to work in Canada.

  

What can I expect to do in this role?

Reporting to the Data Scientist, you will:

Work with departments to identify operational and strategic issues related to extracting value from their data
Identify and define departmental analysis and research needs
Contribute to metadata documentation within enterprise and non-enterprise systems
Analyze small and large datasets to provide descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analyses using univariate and multivariate techniques with potential to develop and present results via reports and slide decks
Conduct appropriate statistical analyses to explore strengths of associations, identify predictions and find trends with the data
Summarize findings when reviewing publicly accessible organizational documentation such as annual reports, online stats or internal analyses
Review and summarize analytical results into reports, presentations and narratives/stories using data visualizations (e.g. charts, graphs, infographics)
Liaise with external system partners (including government and researchers) to identify common research needs that may lead to insight into our data and process and may generate new forms of knowledge to share with the wider oral health community
Conduct data quality analyses to verify the accuracy and reliability of data extracted from Enterprise systems
Utilize project management and agile principles when overseeing and supporting project

 

What skills and background do I need?

The Data & Research Analyst requires:

Undergraduate or associate degree in a related field or a combination of education and relevant experience; master’s and PhD with thesis/dissertation emphasis is an asset
Demonstrated educational experience in the following domains are preferred: statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, economics, sociology, cognition, engineering, neuroscience, psychology, health sciences and data science
Proven experience with hypothesis testing, inferential statistics, predictive modelling within a non-academic organization
Three- to five- years of understanding and coding experience with statistical programming languages or those with statistical and data frame packages for the purpose of statistics, data cleaning and report generation; examples include statistical analysis, database manipulation and report generations such as R, Python, SAS, Stata, SPSS, etc.
Basic coding experience with Microsoft SQL Server (or other programs using SQL) to join and refine tables for future analytics
Proficiency with MS 365
Strong ability to convey complex problems to a wide range of stakeholders and knowledge levels
Experience presenting findings to department or within the organization; experience presenting at conferences an asset
Flexible, adaptable and a demonstrated commitment to learning new skills, software and knowledge domains
Proven organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities to meet deadlines
Experience with gathering requirements from external stakeholders related to data request lifecycle including concepts related to intake communication and analysis, requirements gathering, request analysis, de-identification, report generation and secured data transfer)
Experience researching health information, health data or health policy concepts through environmental scans, literature searches and website navigation are assets
Experience in the healthcare sector as it relates to health data organizations, health facilities or research units an asset
RCDSO is building its bilingual (French/English) capacity and excellent French language proficiency is an asset

 

Compensation and Total Rewards  

Base annual hiring salary from $91,184.94 to $102,583.06, commensurate with experience
Comprehensive extended health benefits package, paid vacation, wellness and sick days 
A matched Pension Plan (up to 8% of salary), Voluntary Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA) and Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP)
Career-related learning and development opportunities
Half-day Fridays between July 1st and September 1st as well as a half-day workday before statutory holidays
Onsite gym, corporate discount to GoodLife Fitness, and wellness-related webinars
Opportunities to connect with colleagues through virtual and in-person social events

How do I apply?

To apply to this vacancy please submit your resume and cover letter describing why you are interested in this position and how your knowledge and skills may be well suited for the role via the RCDSO Job Portal on our Careers page by September 10, 2026 at 5 pm.

 

Our recruitment process is conducted remotely unless otherwise specified. Candidates are welcome to request an in-person interview.

 

Thank you for your interest; only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. 

 

Our inclusive, flexible and collaborative workplace helps us build better regulation that puts the public first. RCDSO does not currently utilize artificial intelligence in its recruitment and selection process.

 

Accommodation is available upon request under the Ontario Human Rights Code.

 

www.rcdso.org
