Description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a member of CIBC’s Capital Markets Technology team, the Consultant, Reporting and Analytics is responsible for supporting the delivery of advanced advice in data analytics, providing research and insights, and ensuring senior management has the relevant information to make informed decisions. The Consultant, Reporting and Analytics applies strong problem framing and solving skills, translate business questions to data requirements and analytical solutions; provides insights that inform decisions influencing department strategy, performs in-depth analysis of research information to identify opportunities, develop relevant dashboards, and makes recommendations for business use. The role performs tasks of technical depth and breadth, utilizing a solid understanding of business dynamics to conduct impact analysis and provide feedback on problems with recommended solutions involving Business Intelligence.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 2-3 days per week on-site, while other days will be remote.

How You’ll Succeed


Data Analysis & Insights - Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to uncover trends and opportunities. Use SQL and Pyspark to process and prepare data for PowerBI dashboard.
Visualization & Reporting - Build interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, or Python visualization libraries.
Strategic Thinking – Drive, manage and execute data and reporting projects and initiatives in alignment with CIBC Strategy while supporting the business goals, objectives, and key performance indicators. Ability to think strategically about how to mobilize and engage teams across the enterprise to deliver strategic change.
Innovative Problem Solving - Actively lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of complex data analytics and visualization solutions
Communication - Excellent verbal and writing skills to effectively articulate ideas and opinions that involve analysis, processes, and technology solutions to others with different disciplinary backgrounds. Ability to produce a variety of business documents that demonstrate command of language, clarity of thought and orderliness of presentation.


Who You Are


You can demonstrate experience in: 3–5 years in data analytics, business intelligence, or related roles. You must have at least 2 years of experience with PowerBI; coupled with at least 4 years of SQL experience. It’s an asset if you have Python and Microsoft Copilot Studio experience, and if you’ve worked within Capital Markets/Equities.
You have a degree in a quantitative field (i.e. mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics, engineering, physics, business) or equivalent experience. Advanced degree is an asset (i.e. MMA, MBAN, MSc, MA, MBA). You have the “Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate” certification.
You are a problem solver. You have exceptional critical thinking, problem solving and decision-making skills with demonstrated ability to independently identify and analyze business problems and recommend solutions.
You demonstrate knowledge in organization's Information Technology (IT) environment and understand the integration / interdependencies of various processes across a line of business.
Your influence makes a difference. You know that relationships and networks are essential to success. You inspire outcomes by sharing your expertise.
You’re digitally savvy. You seek out innovative solutions and embrace evolving technologies. You can easily adapt to new tools and trends.
You're motivated by collective success. You know that teamwork can transform a good idea into a great one. You know that an inclusive team that enjoys working together can bring a vision to life.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.


What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.


We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
Subject to plan and program terms and conditions


What You Need To Know


CIBC is committed to creating an inclusive environment where all team members and clients feel like they belong. We seek applicants with a wide range of abilities and we provide an accessible candidate experience. If you need accommodation, please contact Mailbox.careers-carrieres@cibc.com

Title: Senior Analyst, Market Intelligence
Description:
As a Senior Analyst on the Market Intelligence team at Canadian Tire Corporation, you will play a critical role in shaping and executing competitive intelligence and pricing strategies across multiple banners. You will work collaboratively with cross‑functional partners to translate competitive pricing data into actionable insights that inform pricing decisions at both national and regional levels.

This role is ideal for a strong data analyst or analytics‑leaning candidate who enjoys working with complex datasets, building analytical workflows, and translating data into insights that directly inform pricing and executive decision‑making. Your insights will directly support pricing strategy, executive decision‑making, and the continued evolution of Market Intelligence as a more data‑driven, insight‑led capability.

What You'll Do


Own advanced analysis of competitive pricing data across banners, supporting national and regional initiatives, including competitive pricing behaviour, dispersion, and positioning
Design and execute structured, repeatable analytical approaches that move beyond ad‑hoc reporting to support scalable insight generation
Build and enhance analytical workflows (ex. KNIME-based workflows) to support ongoing pricing analysis, monitoring, and insight delivery, evolving processes from manual to more automated and standardized where appropriate
Translate complex competitive pricing datasets into clear, actionable insights that inform pricing strategy, regional decisions, and leadership discussions
Support the readiness, structure, and usability of competitive pricing data to ensure it is fit for downstream analytics, reporting, and decision‑making
Design, build, and maintain standardized reports and interactive dashboards (ex. Power BI) to monitor competitive pricing, trends, and performance across initiatives
Develop reporting that clearly communicates insights, key drivers, and exceptions to cross‑functional teams and leadership
Ensure all reporting and insights are delivered with appropriate context, assumptions, definitions, and implications to support informed decision‑making
Support executive‑level materials by embedding analytical depth, clear visuals, and concise narratives into competitive pricing updates and presentations
Collaborate closely with Pricing Strategy, Regional Pricing, and Merchandising teams to support and expand Market Intelligence initiatives
Partner with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and translate business questions into well‑structured, actionable analyses
Act as a senior contributor to ensuring competitive data accuracy, consistency, and analytical integrity.
Partner closely with internal teams and external vendor to investigate data issues, define business logic, and resolve data quality challenges.
Proactively identify data gaps or risks and recommend improvements to strengthen analysis and outputs.

3+ years of experience in analytics, pricing, market intelligence, business intelligence, or a related analytical role, preferably within retail, pricing, or a data‑driven business environment

Comprehensive benefits and retirement programs

Aecon Civil is a recognized leader in the market, backed by strong self-perform capabilities and deep local expertise. We play a key role in building and enhancing infrastructure across Canada, the U.S., and an expanding international footprint improving everyday life through the roads, bridges, tunnels, and transit systems that connect communities. With more than a century of experience and a full suite of integrated services, Aecon is a trusted partner for delivering complex civil projects, including tunnels, transit expansions, airports, ports, highways, and large-scale site development.

Reporting to IDD Data & Analytics Lead, the IDD Analytics Specialist will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, transforming, and presenting data from various business systems to support operational, project, and executive decision-making. The role develops reports, dashboards, and performance metrics, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of information to stakeholders.

Design, develop, and maintain reports, scorecards, dashboards, and KPI tracking tools.

Develop recurring operational, project, and corporate performance reports.
Automate reporting processes to improve efficiency and data accuracy.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps.
Perform ad hoc analysis to support business and project initiatives.
Interpret complex data and provide meaningful recommendations to stakeholders.
Monitor key business metrics and produce variance analyses and forecasting reports.

Ensure data quality, consistency, integrity, and governance standards are maintained.
Develop and maintain data models and reporting datasets.
Collaborate with project teams and business leaders to gather reporting requirements.
Translate business needs into reporting and analytical solutions.
Present findings and recommendations to management and executive leadership.
Provide training and support to report users and stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to enhance reporting processes and business intelligence capabilities.
Implement automation and analytics solutions to improve efficiency.
Support the adoption of digital reporting and data visualization tools.
Maintain documentation for reporting methodologies, processes, and data sources.



What You Bring To The Team


Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Information Management, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
Experience with Power Automate, Python, DAX, Power BI datasets, and data extraction from platforms such as ACC, Aconex, ESRI, and SharePoint is considered an asset.
3+ years of experience in reporting, analytics, business intelligence, project controls, or data analysis.
Experience working with large datasets and enterprise systems.
Experience developing executive dashboards and performance reports.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, SQL, Power Query, and data visualization tools to develop dashboards, reports, and data-driven insights.
Experience with data modeling, ETL processes, database querying, and enterprise information systems, including SharePoint and similar platforms.
Ability to analyze, extract, and transform data from multiple sources to support business reporting, decision-making, and process improvement initiatives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data storytelling skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to stakeholders.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and time management skills, with a focus on continuous improvement and business outcomes.

Title: Junior Data Analyst

SureWerx is a leading manufacturer of innovative safety, tool and equipment products and solutions. Since 1957, we've been trusted to keep all who use our products safe in even the most challenging environments. Today, our growing family of world-leading brands serves customers and partners across the U.S., Canada and Europe.

At SureWerx, you'll have the opportunity to challenge yourself in a supportive, growth-oriented culture of industry leaders. You’ll help chart our future as we continue to expand into new products, services and markets. And we’ll invest in your career development, enabling you to grow and succeed.

We are seeking a full-time Junior Data Analyst to join our IT team. Reporting to the Senior Business Analyst, the Junior Data Analyst will support SureWerx leaders by translating business requirements into meaningful insights and dashboards using Power BI. This role will work closely with senior analysts and business stakeholders, gaining hands-on experience with operations, data integrations, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will possess strong technical aptitude, analytical thinking skills, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, growth-oriented setting.

This position is a fully remote role based in Canada. While candidates from across Canada are encouraged to apply, preference will be given to those located in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario.

Responsibilities


Power BI Development: Assist senior analysts to transform data sets into compelling data visualizations including dashboards, flowcharts, graphs and maps to effectively communicate trends and patterns. Assist senior analysts to define and implement best practices.
Data Gathering and Preparation - Collaborate with all team members to understand data and its meaning for proper analysis. Develop complex data extraction and transformation scripts, including data linkages, to prepare data for analysis. Create, optimize and manage complex SQL queries and views.
Requirements Gathering: Assist in documenting requirements from business stakeholders.
Data & Integration Support - Assist with data cleaning, preparation, validation and data mapping activities. Support data migration, integrations, and reconciliation efforts.
Daily Support: Provide ongoing support for Power BI users by monitoring status on issues, troubleshooting data-related and Power BI report issues, resolving technical issues and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
System Development, Support and Testing: Assist in database design and maintenance. Develop test plans and conduct quality assurance testing prior to release of reports to business stakeholders.Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the created reports meet business requirements and function correctly. Assist in rollout of AI tools to accelerate reporting and analysis cycle.
Training: Assist with training end-users.
Presentations: Present to business stakeholders on the implemented reports and dashboards.


Qualifications


Proficient in Power BI, SQL, Copilot, MS Fabric, Excel and related technologies
A bachelor's degree ideally in computer science or mathematics, or a related field is typically required
0–2 years of experience in a business systems, application support, or analyst role.
Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Oracle) is an asset.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work with both technical and non technical stakeholders.
Ability to create and maintain detailed documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
Collaborative and adaptable, able to work effectively within a team and adapt to changing business needs
Strong problem-solving skills, mathematical and analytical skills
Organized, collaborative, and eager to learn in a fast paced environment.


SureWerx is committed to fostering equal opportunities, and to providing an inclusive and respectful working environment in which all employees can thrive. We aim to attract and retain a workforce that represents and celebrates the diverse communities we so proudly serve. We therefore encourage applications from women, LGBTQ+ people, Indigenous Peoples, people of colour, persons with disabilities, and people who are neuro diverse. Title: Data Analyst, People Analytics***Analyste de données, Analytique RH
Description:
IPEX is one of North America’s leading providers of advanced plastic piping systems. Our mission is to shape a better tomorrow by connecting people with water and energy.

We currently have an exciting opportunity as a Data Analyst, People Analytics. This role is based in Montreal or Oakville and reports to the Lead, People Analytics.

Do not miss the opportunity to join a diverse group of people-centric professionals, thought leaders and rapid thinkers, entrepreneurs in spirit and status quo-fighters!

Job Summary

As the Data Analyst, People Analytics, you will help IPEX deliver accurate, meaningful workforce insights that support stronger HR and business decisions. You will be a key partner in managing reporting requests, maintaining data quality, improving reporting processes, and helping stakeholders understand what the data is telling them.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. You will join a People Analytics team that is evolving its reporting practices, strengthening governance, and finding smarter ways to reduce manual work. If you enjoy working with HR data, asking thoughtful questions, and improving how reporting gets done, this role offers the opportunity to make a practical and visible impact.

Principal Responsibilities

Workforce Reporting & Analytics


Help strengthen HR and business decision-making by delivering accurate, timely, and meaningful workforce reporting across recurring cycles and ad hoc requests.
Bring clarity to workforce trends by analyzing metrics such as headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational changes.
Turn reporting needs into practical insights by clarifying business questions and shaping outputs that are useful, relevant, and easy for stakeholders to apply.


Reporting Governance & Data Integrity


Contribute to a trusted people data environment by supporting consistent metric definitions, reporting standards, documentation, and governance practices.
Improve confidence in workforce reporting by validating and reconciling data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies, and supporting quality checks and data integrity reviews.
Help ensure sensitive HR information is handled with accuracy, consistency, confidentiality, and appropriate governance.


Reporting Operations, Automation & Process Improvement


Support a more efficient People Analytics function by maintaining and improving recurring reporting tools, templates, and reporting packages.
Reduce manual effort and improve scalability by applying advanced Excel, Power Query, and automation techniques to recurring reporting activities.
Contribute to ongoing process improvement by identifying opportunities to standardize workflows, simplify reporting processes, and support smaller HR technology or Dayforce-related initiatives where applicable.


Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting Support


Build effective partnerships with HR and business stakeholders by helping clarify reporting needs, priorities, timelines, and appropriate reporting solutions.
Promote stronger data literacy by guiding stakeholders on available reports, metric definitions, governance practices, and appropriate use of workforce data.
Support better reporting discipline by constructively challenging unclear, duplicative, or misaligned requests while communicating findings in a clear and practical way.


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in People Analytics, Workforce Analytics, HR Reporting, HRIS Reporting, Workforce Planning Analytics, or a related analytical role.
Experience delivering recurring and ad hoc workforce reporting, including requirements gathering, data validation, reporting governance, and stakeholder support.
Strong knowledge of HR metrics and workforce data, including headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, retention, demographics, and organizational information.
Advanced Excel skills, with experience using formulas, pivot tables, reporting templates, data validation, and large datasets.
Experience using Power Query or similar tools to transform data, consolidate sources, and improve reporting efficiency.
Experience with HR systems such as Dayforce, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms, and with maintaining or troubleshooting Power BI reports or dashboards.
Strong attention to detail, communication skills, and ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and supporting technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with SQL, Power Automate, Dayforce reporting, workforce planning analytics, reporting automation, or data analytics/visualization certifications is considered an asset.


The compensation for this position is between $70,800.00 and $ 88,500.00 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

Accommodation requests are available to candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process for IPEX jobs. To request an accommodation, please contact HR at askhr@ipexna.com.

Title: Analyst
Description:
Who are we?

At Leadership Connect, we believe that relationships are everything in business and in life. Founded by two former CEOs of S&P 500 companies and a former presidential press secretary, our premier information service is built for developing relationships that impact decisions in government, business, and media. Utilizing deep research expertise and cutting-edge technology, we help our clients win business and influence policy across various specialties and verticals. We are a close-knit team dedicated to helping each of our users make a difference.

Leadership Connect Canada (LCC), a subsidiary of Leadership Connect Inc., is our Canadian entity operating in the province of Quebec.

About The Role

Working within our Data Team, we are seeking an Analyst to conduct and perform research and analysis tasks to develop and maintain our core data assets, people intelligence. The incumbent will actively participate in the development of our data operations activities while ensuring the accuracy and quality of our people intelligence data product. This role is ideal for data enthusiasts and problem solvers, keen on exercising ownership with a passion for empowering users and customers with information solutions that drive sales enablement and improve the collaboration between our customers and the people who are mission-critical to their organization. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, and if you’re passionate about data collection, analysis, and development, we want to hear from you!

Core Functions Of The Role


Execute comprehensive data collection, development, and analysis supporting operational processes with a focus on relevance, precision, and accuracy
Undertaking in-depth analysis into key entities within our People Intelligence data product ensuring current and accurate data
Employ data analysis techniques to discern patterns, derive insights, and identify data quality discrepancies.
Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to appraise data quality or to develop workflows contributing to enhancements in data completeness
Perform in an agile environment, in an operational context while facilitating subject matter interactions between interdisciplinary teams


About You


Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with an interest in people intelligence
1-2 years of experience in data analysis and statistical research
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
Strong organizational and project management skills
Strong time management practices and a proven ability to meet deadlines
Ability to communicate across teams
Proficiency in conducting sophisticated web-based research
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or other data management systems
Practical knowledge of data analytics tools like PowerBI, QuickSight or others is a plus


$40,000 - $55,000 a year

To attract and engage high-level professionals, it is crucial to showcase our expertise, experience, and commitment to fostering valuable connections. We understand the importance of transparency when it comes to salary matters. Our research and analysis of the Quebec market serve as the foundation for determining appropriate salary ranges. However, we also recognize that factors like location, experience, skills alignment, and other compensation considerations may influence these ranges. At Leadership Connect, we place a strong emphasis on open communication and adaptability to ensure fair and competitive compensation. We invite talented individuals to join our team and help us create a workforce that is motivated and empowered to achieve new levels of success.

What Is It Like to Work Here?

We foster an environment that encourages all our team members to excel by offering competitive compensation for top talent. We believe in creating a friendly and enjoyable workplace, with regular team-building events, happy hours, and more. Transparency is key within our company, and we hold monthly town halls led by our CEO to address questions regarding business plans, product direction, and company goals. In addition, we provide flexible PTO policies to ensure you can enjoy your time outside the office and focus on your personal life.

Are you ready to join our dynamic team and build meaningful relationships that make a difference? Apply today!

Benefits/Rewards


Awesome Extended Health Care Plan
Dental Care
Life & Disability insurance
Health spending accounts
Unlimited Vacation Leave
12 Paid Holidays
$3,000 Employee Referral Program
Employer contribution to VRSP
Rewards and recognition programs

Title: Analyst, Quantification and Monitoring of the Credit Portfolio
Description:
Founded in Montreal in 1846, Laurentian Bank is committed to serving its customers and fostering deep relationships with specialized groups. Laurentian Bank runs operations across Canada – primarily in Québec and Ontario – as well as in the United States and competes where it sees market opportunity and has an edge, while harnessing the power of partnerships and collaboration.

This role sits within Laurentian Bank.

The selected candidate serves as an Analyst within the team responsible for credit portfolio monitoring and oversight activities.

Responsibilities


Participate in the production of dashboards used to monitor the performance of the Bank’s credit portfolios.
Participate in the analysis of performance indicators related to the Bank’s credit portfolio.
Produce analyses, interpret data, explain variances, and assess their implications on the Bank’s results.
Participate in data quality analysis in collaboration with governance teams.
Participate in the migration of various reports and publications to the new data model.


Qualifications


University degree in Data Science and Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Finance, or any other related field.
Minimum of 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in Data Science or Risk Management.


Specific Skills


Strong knowledge of database querying and management using SQL, as well as specialized statistical tools such as SAS (Enterprise Guide), Power BI and Tableau.
Ability to influence stakeholders and innovate in the solutions proposed.
Ability to simplify and communicate complex ideas effectively.
Knowledge of the banking industry, Canadian credit products, and credit risk management tools.
Strong analytical mindset with a problem-solving orientation.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to work.
Bilingual* (English and French)
Professional working proficiency in French and English languages required as position involves frequent written and oral communication on complex matters with internal and external parties in both languages.


What Laurentian Bank Has To Offer You

The total compensation offered by Laurentian Bank encompasses a comprehensive range of benefits, highlighting our commitment to the well-being and success of our employees. Here are some of the key points of our offering:


Total compensation: Earn a comprehensive compensation package that includes annual reviews and performance-based bonuses.
Work model: We prioritize a hybrid work model based on business needs.
Stock purchase plan: Become not just an employee, but a Laurentian Bank shareholder. Employer matching takes your investment even further.
Time off: In addition to paid vacation, we provide floating days and leave options to accommodate the diverse needs of our employees. Plus, as an extra perk, you also get a paid day off to celebrate your birthday.
Health and wellness: Take care of your health and well-being with access to healthcare professionals, our Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), and a Stress Management and Well-Being Program.
Group insurance and pension: We offer a competitive insurance program based on your family’s needs and a defined contribution pension plan to help prepare for your future.
Financial benefits: As a Laurentian Bank employee, you’re also the best ambassador for our products and services. Take advantage of employee-only offers on a wide range of products. Enjoy exclusive deals and preferred rates on products and services including insurance, hotels, train tickets, spas and many more.


We are committed to creating a fulfilling professional environment where your skills are valued, and your well-being is a priority. Join us for a rewarding career at Laurentian Bank.

Inclusion and Accessibility

Our Company

Job Summary

The Production Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting production data to improve operational efficiency, product quality, and manufacturing performance. This role works closely with finance, production, quality assurance, maintenance, supply chain, and continuous improvement teams to identify trends, improve production processes, reduce waste, and support data-driven decision-making in a food manufacturing environment.

Collect, validate, and analyze production data from manufacturing systems, ERP, MES, and other operational databases.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), including production yield, downtime, waste and scrap, labor efficiency, line performance, and product quality.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Excel and other reporting tools.
Identify trends, production bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce costs.
Collaborate with production supervisors and plant management to investigate production issues and recommend corrective actions.
Analyze root causes of production losses, quality deviations, and equipment downtime.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of production data through regular audits and validation checks.
Generate daily, weekly, and monthly production performance reports for management.
Support production capacity planning, forecasting, and resource utilization.
Work with Quality Assurance to analyze product quality data and support food safety compliance.
Maintain documentation of reporting processes, data definitions, and standard operating procedures.
Participate in cross-functional projects that support continuous improvement and operational excellence.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Statistics, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in data analysis within food manufacturing or a manufacturing environment preferred but not required.
Experience working with ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor).
Knowledge of food manufacturing processes and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).




Technical Skills

Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, formulas)
Experience with ERP and manufacturing systems
Knowledge of statistical analysis techniques
Understanding of manufacturing KPIs and production reporting




Core Competencies

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy
Data analysis and trend identification
Continuous improvement mindset
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment
Effective communication and presentation skills
Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Accuracy and timeliness of production reports
Data quality and reporting accuracy
Improvement in production efficiency
Reduction in production waste and scrap
Reduction in equipment downtime
Cost savings identified through data analysis
Dashboard adoption and stakeholder satisfaction
Support for continuous improvement initiatives




Working Conditions

Primarily office-based with regular visits to the production floor.
Must be comfortable working in a food manufacturing environment, including exposure to refrigerated areas, noise, and production equipment.
Occasional flexibility in work hours may be required to support production schedules or month-end reporting.




Pay: CA$55,000.00 - CA$70,000.00 per year

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
This is a hybrid position based out of North York @ 243 Consumers Rd - You will work 4 days a week in office and 1 day a week remote

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts, and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare provider in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness, and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst to design, build, and deliver enterprise reporting and analytics solutions within a modern Microsoft Fabric and Azure ecosystem.

This is a development-focused role. You will be responsible for building Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and reporting assets from end to end—transforming raw data into scalable, production-ready reporting solutions that drive business decisions across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Power BI, data modeling, SQL, and Microsoft Fabric with a passion for delivering high-quality reporting experiences that are performant, reliable, and user-friendly.

Key Responsibilities:

Power BI Development & Reporting Delivery


Design, develop, test, and deploy Power BI dashboards and reports from concept to production
Build operational, financial, and executive reporting solutions that support strategic decision-making
Create intuitive, visually compelling, and pixel-perfect dashboards following UX and visualization best practices
Develop reusable reporting frameworks, templates, and standards
Deliver both standardized reporting solutions and ad hoc analytical reporting requests
Serve as the primary owner for reporting deliverables and dashboard lifecycle management



Data Modeling & Semantic Layer Development


Design and maintain enterprise semantic models and Power BI datasets
Develop advanced DAX measures, KPIs, and business calculations
Build scalable dimensional and star-schema data models optimized for reporting performance
Establish and maintain a trusted single source of truth for business metrics and reporting
Ensure consistency and accuracy across all reporting assets



Microsoft Fabric & Data Integration


Develop solutions using Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows, and Data Pipelines
Source, cleanse, transform, and prepare data for reporting and analytics use cases
Partner with Data Engineering teams to consume curated Gold-layer datasets
Contribute to reporting-focused data pipeline development and optimization
Support data integration efforts across multiple business systems and data sources



Stakeholder Engagement & Delivery


Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into actionable reporting solutions
Lead report design discussions and iterative feedback sessions
Prioritize and deliver reporting assets aligned with business objectives
Communicate insights, recommendations, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences



Performance Optimization & Scalability


Optimize report performance through efficient DAX, model design, and query tuning
Ensure reporting solutions remain scalable across large and growing datasets
Monitor dashboard adoption, usage patterns, and performance metrics
Continuously improve reporting efficiency, usability, and responsiveness



Data Governance & Quality


Apply enterprise standards for naming conventions, documentation, and metadata management
Validate data accuracy and ensure reporting reliability
Support governance initiatives related to reporting, metrics, and business definitions
Maintain documentation for datasets, reports, and reporting processes



Mentorship & Best Practices


Promote best practices in Power BI development, data modeling, and visualization design
Mentor junior analysts and BI developers
Contribute to establishing a Reporting and Analytics Center of Excellence
Drive continuous improvement in BI development standards and methodologies



What we're looking for:


5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or Reporting-focused roles
Proven experience building Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models from scratch
Advanced expertise in Power BI, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure-based data platforms
Strong SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and optimization
Experience delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade reporting solutions
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schema design, and reporting best practices
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Strong builder mindset with a passion for hands-on development
Ability to independently translate business requirements into production-ready solutions
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data quality
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent collaboration and stakeholder engagement abilities
Focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, and user experience
Continuous learning mindset and willingness to adopt emerging technologies



Nice to Have


Experience with Python for automation, analytics, or data preparation
Familiarity with CI/CD processes for Power BI deployments
Experience with Power BI deployment pipelines and workspace administration



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, and Real-Time Analytics
Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
Experience implementing reporting governance and enterprise BI standards
Familiarity with additional reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau, SSRS, or Looker
Exposure to advanced analytics, machine learning, or data science workflows



Success Metrics


Delivery of high-quality Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions
Dashboard adoption and engagement across business teams
Report performance, reliability, and scalability
Stakeholder satisfaction and business impact
Reduction in manual reporting effort
Consistency and adherence to BI standards and governance practices



Why Join Us


Opportunity to help build and scale a modern enterprise reporting ecosystem using Microsoft Fabric
High-impact role with ownership of critical reporting and analytics solutions
Exposure to cutting-edge cloud data and analytics technologies
Collaborative, data-driven culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement
Career growth opportunities into BI Lead, Analytics Architect, or Data Platform leadership roles



Inclusion

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive. Improving inclusion and equity is a collective responsibility. Lifemark promotes equal employment opportunities for all job applicants, including but not limited to those self-identifying as a member of the employment equity groups: Indigenous peoples, Newcomers to Canada, Women, and Visible minorities.

Accommodation

Accommodations are available on request for all candidates taking part in any aspect of the recruitment and selection process. Email us at Talentatlifemark.ca.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst, Marketing
Description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.




Job Summary:

Toptal is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to provide marketing leaders with crucial insights and recommendations for improvement. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where Analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. This role will specifically work with our Marketing organization—spanning paid search (SEM), organic search (SEO), and emerging Generative AI channels—from structuring the underlying data infrastructure to developing reports that support marketing leaders in making data-driven decisions. This role will play a critical role as a strategic advisor to marketing functions and leaders. This person will use data, create and define metrics, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis.




Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand the business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between data analysis, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. We are looking for someone who is excited about seeing the bigger picture to make cross-functional connections in marketing channels, financial performance, and data. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not. The Senior Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude.




This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.




Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders.
Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives.
Measure and diagnose the performance of SEM, SEO, and Generative AI channels—analyzing spend efficiency, keyword and query performance, organic visibility and share of voice, funnel conversion, and lead value/ROAS—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.
Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation.
Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc.
Work closely with marketing stakeholders, data analysts, and business process owners to empower data-backed decision making, balancing and prioritizing competing requests across teams.
Leverage Generative AI tools (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, automate reporting workflows, and evaluate the growing impact of AI-driven search and referral channels on marketing performance.
Build and maintain marketing data infrastructure from lead acquisition to revenue generation, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads as required.




Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree is required.
5+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
2+ years of experience within general consulting or an analytical operations function is required.
Demonstrated experience analyzing SEM (paid search), SEO (organic search), and Generative AI / AI-driven search channels is required.
Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions.
  • Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders.
  • Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives.
  • Measure and diagnose the performance of SEM, SEO, and Generative AI channels—analyzing spend efficiency, keyword and query performance, organic visibility and share of voice, funnel conversion, and lead value/ROAS—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy.

  • Build and maintain marketing data infrastructure from lead acquisition to revenue generation, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads as required.


Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence is required, with a focus on marketing analytics.
  • 2+ years of experience within general consulting or an analytical operations function is required.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing SEM (paid search), SEO (organic search), and Generative AI / AI-driven search channels is required.
  • Both a strong background in math, science, finance, engineering, or statistics and deep business insight is required; advanced degrees and/or MBA are a plus.
  • Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.).
  • Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting.
  • Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance.
  • Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact.
  • Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus.
  • Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots.
  • The ideal candidate needs to have a strong technical background particularly when it comes to marketing data infrastructure and Google products (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Ads) while having the ability to master marketing processes of diverse nature.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.

Children Believe is currently recruiting for the following position:




Data & Insights Analyst

Canada Office

The Data & Insights Analyst is the data engine of Children Believe's Marketing & Development (M&D) division. This role is responsible for turning raw data into clear, actionable intelligence — ensuring the division runs on facts, not assumptions, and that every team has the reporting and insights it needs to make smarter decisions and demonstrate impact.

Reporting to the Manager, M&D Operations, this role owns the integrity and usability of M&D's CRM data, manages the full reporting and dashboard ecosystem, and drives innovation in how the division uses digital data and AI-powered tools. It is a hands-on, execution-focused role with real strategic value — the outputs produced here directly shape how the CMDO and M&D Directors measure performance, allocate resources, and tell their story to donors and stakeholders.

This is an ideal role for an analytically strong early-career professional who is eager to grow, build meaningful systems, and see their work directly connected to a mission that changes children's lives.

This role includes, but not limited to:

1. Reporting & Dashboards - 35%

Build, maintain, and continuously improve M&D's suite of performance dashboards and KPI reports — ensuring every team has timely, accurate visibility into what matters most.
Produce the monthly M&D KPI dashboard for the CMDO and Directors, incorporating charts, trend analysis, and narrative highlights.
Develop standardized reporting templates that reduce manual effort and increase consistency across the division.
Respond to ad hoc data and reporting requests from M&D Directors and the CMDO with accuracy and speed.
Proactively surface insights, anomalies, and trends — don't just report the numbers, explain what they mean.

2. CRM Data Management & Integrity - 30%

Own the quality and reliability of M&D's CRM data — including donor records, contact information, gift history, and segmentation — ensuring it is clean, consistent, and complete.
Design and implement data entry standards, hygiene protocols, and audit processes to prevent data degradation over time.
Lead regular data clean-up initiatives: deduplication, record merging, field standardization, and validation.
Build CRM queries, segments, and lists to support fundraising campaigns, donor communications, and strategic analysis.
Act as the go-to resource for CRM data questions across M&D — supporting teams in getting the most out of the system.
Liaise with the CRM platform provider and IT as needed on system issues, upgrades, and data imports/exports.

3. Digital Data & External Sources - 20%

Manage and interpret data from digital channels including website analytics (Google Analytics), SEO platforms, email marketing tools, and social media insights.
Ensure digital data sources are properly connected, consistently tracked, and integrated into M&D reporting where relevant.
Monitor digital performance trends and provide regular reporting to the Digital & Community Engagement team and the CMDO.
Support campaign measurement and attribution — helping teams understand what is driving donor acquisition, engagement, and conversion.

4. AI & Innovation - 15%

Research, pilot, and implement AI-powered tools that improve reporting efficiency, data quality, and analytical depth across M&D.
Identify repetitive or manual data tasks that can be automated — and build or configure solutions to eliminate them.
Stay current on emerging data and AI tools relevant to non-profit fundraising and digital marketing; bring recommendations to the Manager, M&D Operations.
Support the broader M&D team in developing data literacy and comfort with new tools through documentation, training, and hands-on support.

The ideal candidate possesses:

Required

Post-secondary diploma or degree in a relevant field (Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Marketing, Communications, Statistics, or equivalent experience).
1–3 years of experience in a data, reporting, or analytics role; non-profit or fundraising experience is an asset but not required.
Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data visualization.
Working proficiency in Power BI (or equivalent BI/dashboard tool), with the ability to build and maintain reporting dashboards.
Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4) and digital marketing measurement fundamentals.
Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines consistently.
Clear and effective written communication — can explain findings to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated commitment to Children Believe's Vision, Mission, and Values.

Assets

Experience with AI or automation tools applied to data tasks (e.g., Python scripting, ChatGPT/Claude for data analysis, Zapier, or similar).
Proficiency in CRM platforms (Dynamics or equivalent); experience with data entry standards and database hygiene.
Experience with SEO platforms (SEMrush, Moz, Google Search Console).
Knowledge of email marketing platforms and campaign performance metrics.
Experience in a fundraising, marketing, or donor communications environment.
Familiarity with Intacct or similar accounting/finance software.
Proficiency in French or Spanish.

Attributes, Traits, Behaviours:

Analytical Rigour

Finds patterns and meaning in complex datasets. Works accurately under pressure and checks their own work before presenting it. Numbers tell a story — this person knows how to read it.

Attention to Detail

Data quality is only as good as the person maintaining it. This role requires someone who notices what others miss and takes ownership of getting things exactly right.

Curiosity & Initiative

Doesn't wait to be told what to investigate. Proactively digs into the data, asks good questions, and brings ideas — including how AI and automation can improve the way M&D works.

Communication Clarity

Translates technical findings into plain language that non-data audiences can act on. Knows when a table works and when a chart tells the story better.

Systems Thinking

Understands how data flows connect across tools, teams, and processes. Builds solutions that are sustainable and scalable — not just fixes for today's problem.

Type: Hybrid

Our Hybrid Workplace Program is a flexible work arrangement that permits employees to work remotely while also occasionally being required to come into the Organization’s office. If approved to work from home as part of our Hybrid workplace program; the incumbent must be available to work from the Organization’s office from time to time as determined by the supervisor or as otherwise directed by the Organization.

Compensation: Between $51,000 - $60,000 annually based on experience.




We value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your professional and personal growth:

Competitive Compensation Package: We provide an attractive compensation package with clearly stated hiring ranges.
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a flexible work environment, including hybrid work options, flexible hours, “No Meeting Mondays,” and the option to work up to 20 days out of province per year.
Comprehensive Benefits Plan: Our group benefits plan includes health and dental coverage, an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), and RRSP matching up to 5%, starting from day one.
Health Spending Account: Access to our $500 Healthcare Spending Account to top up expenses not covered in the benefits program

Professional Development: Benefit from 5 paid professional development days and experience professional growth through a variety of learning opportunities.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy an annual Christmas closure, receive 2 float days, and have access to up to 10 sick day
Generous Vacation Policy: Enjoy 3 weeks paid vacation with incremental increase every 5 years up to 6 weeks.
Other Employee Perks: Take advantage of our Employee Discount Program and various other perks designed to enhance your overall well-being and work-life balance.

Conduct quantitative analysis and financial modelling to evaluate feature design opportunities, assess risks, and support strategic investment decisions in UT.
Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.

Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making.

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making.
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis.
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a plus.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…

The Data Analyst utilizes their quantitative analytical skills and scientific thought process to interpret and

analyze large sets of complex data, while extracting meaningful insights for Kabam. This role works

closely with our internal gaming team to optimize every facet of player retention and monetization to

ensure the continued success of our games.

This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

Provide Cross-functional Support

In this role, you can expect to:


Collaborate with various teams across the organization to understand their business goals and data needs.
Improve reporting processes by identifying inefficiencies and suggesting enhancements.
Assist with larger-scale projects as required, contributing data-driven insights.


Data Exploration And Analysis


Use SQL to extract and manipulate data from various sources.
Perform hands-on exploration of data sets to answer business questions.
Utilize statistical analysis to identify trends, correlations, and patterns within the data.
Create data visualizations to communicate findings effectively.


Dashboard And Report Management


Develop and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports tailored to the needs of different teams within the organization.
Ensure that dashboards and reports are up-to-date and accurate.
Prepare ad-hoc reports as requested.


A/B Testing


Design, execute, and manage multiple A/B tests to gain insights into key performance indicators (KPIs) such as retention, acquisition, and monetization.
Analyze the results of A/B tests to draw actionable conclusions.
Make data-driven recommendations for optimizing business strategies based on results of A/B testing.


Product Feature Analysis And Optimization


Measure the success of newly released product features using key metrics and data analysis.
Drive data-driven iteration and optimization of product features to enhance performance and user experience.


Task Prioritization And Project Management


Assist in task prioritization within the data team based on business needs and project requirements.
Collaborate with team members to achieve project goals efficiently.


To Be Successful In This Role, Your Background Includes


Bachelor’s Degree in related field.
3+ years of industry data analysis experience, with solid knowledge of statistical methods.
1+ years of industry data experience in games (mobile, console, PC), online casino, slot games, or any high volume B2C mobile apps.
Expert SQL skills and experience querying very large data sets.
Proven ability to thrive using multiple mixed, varied, and inconsistent data sources.
Fundamental knowledge of project management methodologies.
Regular communication with stakeholders from other departments and drive actionable items for continuous improvement.
Experience with Google BigQuery, Tableau, JIRA and/or other project management software.
Experience working for a social or mobile game developer.
Understanding of game design concepts and principles.


Benefits

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:


Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Location: This hybrid role requires 2-3 days on-site at our Burnaby, BC office.

Welcome to Specsavers – where we’re not just about eyecare and eyewear, but changing lives through better sight. Ranked the 5th Best Workplace™ in Canada and 12th globally by Great Place to Work®, we’re proud of our optometrist-owned model that makes high-quality, eyecare and eyewear accessible to all Canadians.

Founded 40 years ago in the UK by visionary husband and wife optometry duo Doug and Mary Perkins, Specsavers has remained privately owned since day one. Today, we are a $7.8 billion global business with over 45,000 colleagues across more than 2,700 retail optical locations.

In Canada, our support office is based in Burnaby, BC. Since entering the market in 2021, we’ve been scaling rapidly, now with over 270 locations nationwide. With advanced clinical equipment and a wide range of affordable, high-quality eyewear, we’re transforming the way Canadians experience eyecare.

If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of a values-driven organization, join us as we continue to grow. Together, we can change lives through better sight.

What You’ll Do

The Data Analyst delivers Power BI visualizations and dashboards that tell a story using data, drive action, and deliver value to the business. You work within a cross-functional product team, with support from product owners, business analysts, data engineers and data scientists where needed. You will also support the business in the transformation by contributing towards beginners’ sessions, drop-ins, and show-and-tell sessions demonstrating the capability of Power BI and wider visualization best practice.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver


Work with stakeholders and other data team colleagues to understand the data and insights needed to address business questions and challenges
Use visualization techniques to tell data stories, delivering insight to the business in a compelling way
Design and implement analytics reporting dashboards and visualizations using SQL and Power BI
Work with engineers to model, reshape and prepare data to optimize dashboard performance
Collaborate within the wider Data Team and Technology where required for the successful end-to-end delivery of the analytics solution
Work with business end-users to ensure the best user experience
Manage stakeholder expectations on analytical work by providing regular written and verbal communications, building trust, and forming close working relationships


Transform


Be a subject matter expert in visualization and Power BI
Continually improve your own knowledge, including participating in the Specsavers data visualization and storytelling training programme, and other training events
Share your knowledge with less experienced colleagues
Keep up to date on the latest analytics & visualization innovation, share ideas and highlight opportunities to adopt them
Encourage use of data visualization and storytelling in decision making


What We’re Looking For


3-5 years of experience as a Data Analyst across the data lifecycle, from data modelling and transformation to visualization and analytics, leveraging SQL, Power BI, Databricks, and related tools.
Experience manipulating. transforming and cleansing data, and building compelling visualizations, ideally in Power BI
Experience delivering reports, dashboards, or visualization projects in a business context
Intermediate SQL for analytics
Able to convey complex concepts to non-technical audiences in a succinct and accessible way
A collaborative approach to working, with good relationship building skills
Capability in DAX, Power Query or equivalent


Nice-to-have


Experience working with stakeholders to refine requirements and design outputs
Mentoring or coaching experience
Experience in Python or PySpark
Experience working in any capacity in retail or ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, healthcare or other regulated environments such as telco, financial services and utilities.


Compensation: $80,000 - $95,000 base salary, plus quarterly bonus, profit sharing, and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience

Speccies’ Benefits


4 weeks of vacation and 1 paid volunteer day per year
1 extra paid day off plus an eyecare voucher to celebrate your birthday.
Health and dental benefits, RRSP matching and a Healthcare Spending Account active from your first day.
Mental health and wellbeing support, including $3,000 annually for practitioner care and access to our Employee Assistance Program.
Quarterly bonuses, based on your performance.
Annual Profit Share program to recognize your part in Specsavers’ success.
Free parking, access to the building gym, and a fully stocked kitchen with snacks and coffee/tea.
On‑site wellness offerings in-office, including RMT and yoga sessions.
Team and company social events, including holiday and annual celebrations.


Behaviours We Value


Collaborative: We work together as one Specsavers to deliver on our purpose
Curious: We question, explore, and seek out diverse perspectives to develop our knowledge and understanding
Courageous: We challenge the status quo, we experiment with good ideas, and we are brave, bold, and fast in our decision making
Compassionate: We care, support, and help each other
Commercial: We treat money wisely and make decisions that are good for our customers, our partners, our people and for the long term


We hope that in applying with us, you value these things as well!

Our Hybrid Work Model

Experience the best of both worlds. At Specsavers, we embrace a hybrid approach that balances in-office collaboration with the flexibility to work from home. We come together in office two to three days a week to connect, innovate, and keep our culture thriving.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Specsavers, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that a diverse team enriches our work environment and enables us to achieve our goals. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage candidates of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you believe you can contribute to our mission and vision, we welcome your application, even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We value the unique skills and perspectives each individual brings to our team.

Accessibility and Accommodations

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. If you require accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know by contacting us at careers.ca@specsavers.com . We will work with you to meet your needs and ensure a fair and equitable experience.

Title: Advanced Data Analyst - EA SPORTS™ FC
Description:
Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Advanced Data Analyst, Experimentation Lead - FC Ultimate Team

As one of the largest sports entertainment platforms in the world, EA SPORTS FC is redefining football with genre-leading interactive experiences, connecting a global community of fans to The World's Game through innovation and unrivaled authenticity.

With more opportunity than ever to design, innovate and create new, immersive experiences that bring joy, inclusivity, and connection to fans everywhere, we invite you to join our passionate and dynamic team as we pioneer the future of football fandom.

The FC Data & Analytics team is seeking an Advanced Data Analyst to join our Ultimate Team (UT) function. Reporting to a Senior Manager, you will lead the Experimentation program for FC Premium Analytics. You’ll also collaborate closely with data, production, and product management partners to drive informed decision-making within a dynamic live service environment.

We are looking for a candidate who is excited at the prospect of cultivating and uncovering actionable insights from live player data and contributing to the sustained success of one of the industry's most prominent live service products. In this role, you will act as a data leader, driving design, implementation, and evaluation of numerous player-facing experiments.

What You'll Do On Our Team


Collaborate with production teams to define telemetry requirements, ensuring robust data collection and validity.
Design and implement player-facing experimentation using best practices in a complex, live environment
Write and maintain complex SQL and scripting workflows to extract, transform, and validate large-scale telemetry datasets
Build and maintain scalable dashboards that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable business insights for cross-functional partners
Explore user behavioral patterns through experimentation to identify opportunities for improving player experiences and to inform live content release strategies
Present analytical findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders of all seniority levels to facilitate informed decision-making
Act as a subject-matter expert in all things experimentation, helping to drive adoption of a data-driven, test-and-learn focused culture across FC’s development team


What We're Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research) or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of technical experience in data analytics, with a focus on performing quantitative analysis with large datasets to guide decision-making
Expert knowledge or equivalent practical experience in leading an experimentation function for a live product
Proficiency in SQL with the ability to extract data from complex, multi-source systems.
Hands-on experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, R) with experience writing scripts for data transformation and statistical analysis
Passion for gaming or previous experience in the gaming industry is considered a strong plus.


Pay Transparency - North America

Compensation And Benefits

The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs).

PAY RANGES


British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$114,300 - $156,200 CAD


Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

For Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, paid top-up to EI/QPIP benefits up to 100% of base salary when you welcome a new child (12 weeks for maternity, and 4 weeks for parental/adoption leave), extended health/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, disability insurance, retirement plan to regular full-time employees. Certain roles may also be eligible for bonus and other incentive programs.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
